# Keydemand V2 Phase 1 — Business Rules & Requirements Knowledge Base

**As of:** 2026-11-06 · **Entry point:** *Keydemand V2 Phase 1 - Delivery Plan.xlsx* (Drive `1LvPiNQFNLQu-IYuu-1VNS47Y952OaR6L`)

## What this file is

This file brings together the **core Keydemand V2 Phase 1 business documents**:
- business rules and change requests (CRs), plus client clarifications
- product requirements and the PRD, stories and epics
- the Master Sheet fields
- input fields and listing management
- relevancy logic
- every page and user-journey document (Landing, Enterprise, Agent, Brand Retail/F&B, Office Tenant, Managed Space, Keydemand Team)
- the Control Panel and admin
- roles, notifications and the high-ticket lead (HTL) workflow
- the post-production change requests of the November 2026 sprint (in the CR group)
- the **product documentation as built** (group 16): the product overview, the persona journeys checked on SIT, the Admin Control Panel documentation, and the list of places where the app differs from those documents

Every source was read line by line, and each current document is transcribed in full: headings, tables, field lists, options, limits, examples and comments.

Every atomic rule gets a stable ID, `BR-<AREA>-<NNN>`, with the source section cited next to it.

**The source documents are read-only.** Nothing in Drive was edited, commented on or changed. This file is the only output.

## Scope and authority

- **Only current (AUTHORITATIVE) documents are included.** That means the highest "Version N.N" in the title; if titles tie, the latest modified date.
- **Older versions (HISTORY) and non-authoritative docs are listed by name only** in the Source register. Non-authoritative docs include the "Relevancy Business Guide — DO NOT TAKE" and the empty "Rough 2" draft.
- **Group 16 describes the product as built, not what was decided.** It was written from the code and the running app after go-live. It never overrides a requirement on its own. Where it differs from a requirement, the difference is listed in the conflict register as "Needs decision": either the requirement is out of date or the product has a defect.
- **When two current documents disagree,** a later-dated CR or decision overrides an earlier one. Every such clash is listed under **Cross-document conflicts & decisions needed**, so you can confirm it rather than have it silently resolved.

## Rule ID prefixes

| Prefix | Area | Prefix | Area |
|---|---|---|---|
| CR | Change requests & business-rule changes | PG1 | Landing, Enterprise, Agent pages, user journeys |
| DQ | Clarifications, doubts, client Q&A | PG2 | Occupier pages (Brand Retail/F&B, Office Tenant, Managed Space) |
| REQ | PRD, requirements, stories, epics | KDT | Keydemand Team pages & dashboard |
| MS | Master Sheet fields (story-wise) | ADM | Control Panel & admin |
| FLD | Input fields, cards, bulk upload, listings | ROL / NTF / HTL | Roles · notifications · high-ticket-lead workflow |
| REL | Relevancy / matching logic | PD | Product documentation as built (overview, persona journeys, Control Panel, doc-vs-app findings) |

Rule numbers can have gaps. Rules from superseded documents were removed, but the remaining IDs were never renumbered.

  - the client-discussion folders
- **Excluded by decision (2026-10-23):** invoices, third-party pitch decks, media, bug lists and progress slides.
- **FAQ (green, i.e. current, in the Delivery Plan link list):** Drive `1q8mVbidN6Bp0VlofoRNtwx5Z62BcbSke`. It's UNREADABLE ("Requested entity was not found"), so it was probably deleted or not shared. It needs a working link or a copy.
- **Reference folders listed by name only (2026-11-06):** the FRD drafts and PDF exports in "Admin related- Tbsorted", the developer documents copied from the code repository ("docs- got it from github-made by Satish. just for reference"), the "How to" videos, meeting notes written by Gemini, weekly summaries and bug lists. Group 16's notes name the files.
- **Outside Google Drive:** the Figma design, the SharePoint workbook, Teams and live app URLs. Connected tools can't open these.
- **Images:** many could not be viewed. They are marked `[Image: …]`.
- **Credentials:** replaced with `[REDACTED-credential]`.

## Adding new documents or changes

1. Read the new doc fully, following `kb/_brief.md`.
2. Either add it to the right `kb/sections/NN-*.md`, or create a new group file and add it to `INCLUDE` in `kb/build.py`.
3. If it supersedes a doc, mark the old one `[HISTORY — superseded by …]`. The build drops it automatically.
4. Re-check `kb/sections/00-core-cross-doc.md` for new conflicts.
5. Add a line to `kb/changelog.md`.
6. Rebuild by running `python3 kb/build.py`.

## Cross-document conflicts, decisions needed & glossary

Scope: core business-rule groups G02–G12, authoritative documents only. From 2026-11-06 it also compares them with G16, the product documentation as built.

**Scope.** This chapter is built from the "Group-level notes" and "Open questions" sections of groups 02–12, plus targeted searches of the BR lines across groups. It covers clashes **between different groups**. Clashes inside one group are already listed in that group's notes and are repeated here only when another group adds a further position.

**How to read it.**
- "G04" means group file `04-requirements.md`, and so on.
- Authority follows `kb/00-header.md`: within a document family, the highest "Version N.N" wins. Between authoritative documents, the later-dated CR or decision wins.
- Key dates used below: CR "Final" sheet (G02, 2026-08-03); Product Requirements Oct 2 (G04, 2026-10-10); Version 1.0 Master Sheet (G05, 2026-10-08); Sep 16 field sheets (G06); Version 1.0 Landing (G08, 2026-10-15); Version 1.0 Enterprise and All User Journeys (G08, 2026-10-06); Version 1.1 Agent (G08, 2026-10-02); Version 1.0 occupier pages (G09, 2026-09-28 / 10-03); Version 2.0 KD Specific Page (G10, 2026-10-06); Version 2.0 Control Panel (G11, 2026-10-09); Roles guide doc 2 (G12, 2026-10-06).
- **G16 (added 2026-11-06)** describes the product as built: product overview (status date 2026-10-28), persona journeys checked on SIT (2026-11-03 to 2026-11-05) and the Admin Control Panel documentation (2026-11-05). An as-built statement does not override a requirement. Lines starting "As built (G16)" under a decision, and register rows C-72 onward, show where the built product stands so that each difference can be decided: update the requirement, or fix the product.
- The G02 "November 2026 sprint" sheet (approved 3–4 Nov 2026) holds the latest dated change requests; they override earlier rules on the same point.
- No document status assigned in a group file is changed here. Where this chapter doubts a group's in-group resolution, it says so as "Doubt:".

### Decisions needed (top priority)

**D-01 — Contact-request response window (4 working days vs 72 hours)**
- Sources disagree: G05 V1.0 Master says brands have 4 working days, excluding Sat/Sun (BR-MS-180), and that requests auto-drop at exactly 72 h (BR-MS-181). G08 Agent V1.1 says the same pair (BR-PG1-145 vs BR-PG1-146). G09 Retail/F&B V1.0 says the same pair (BR-PG2-031/032, BR-PG2-105/106). G12 says 4 working days only (BR-ROL-006). G04 says 72 h only (BR-REQ-112, BR-REQ-167), as do G06 (BR-FLD-145), G08 Agent Complete Journey (BR-PG1-227, BR-PG1-241). G03 adds a 24-hour reminder (BR-DQ-105/106).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **unresolved.** Every latest authoritative doc states both values. 72 calendar hours always expires before 4 working days (G05 open question), so the 4-day window can never be reached.
- Question to confirm: Is the window 72 calendar hours or 4 working days, and should the other value be deleted everywhere?
- As built (G16): a contact request to a brand expires after 72 hours with no answer (BR-PD-0722), with a reminder at 48 hours and an "expired" notice to the requester at 72 hours (BR-PD-1722, BR-PD-1826). No as-built document mentions 4 working days.

**D-02 — Agent subscription price structure (bundles, ROI, combined price, subscriber contact cap)**
- Sources disagree:
  - G04 Oct 2: Metro ₹1000 / Non-Metro ₹750 per asset class per city, "Both" ₹2000 / ₹1500. ROI ₹1000 per asset class, Pan India ₹5000, with no "Both" price for either (BR-REQ-001/002/003).
  - G05 V1.0 and G08 V1.1: the same figures per bundle, with combined Metro ₹2000 / Non-Metro ₹1500 (BR-MS-090/091, BR-PG1-169).
  - G11 CP V2.0: "Rest of India ₹1,000 flat", Pan India ₹5,000 flat, no combined bundle (BR-ADM-050).
  - G03 Himanshu: three other price sets (Metro 1500 / Non-metro 1000; ₹1000 / ₹750 per city; ₹1000 per asset class) and **5 contact views per month per city × asset class for subscribers** (BR-DQ-085, BR-DQ-108). G05 says subscribers get **unlimited** contacts (BR-MS-029), and so does G04 (BR-REQ-170).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: G04/G05/G08 (October) agree on Metro, Non-Metro and Pan India and supersede G03 (March–June). The unlimited-contacts rule governs. **Still open:** the combined-bundle price (absent from G11 V2.0, the latest CP doc), whether ROI is per asset class or flat, and the billing period and GST (G04 open question).
- Question to confirm: Does a combined (Retail & F&B + Office) bundle price exist, and is ROI ₹1000 per bundle or flat?

**D-03 — Number of admin roles and the undefined "Ops User"**
- Sources disagree: G02 Final (BR-CR-004) and G11 V2.0 (BR-ADM-004) give 3 roles: Super Admin / Admin / Ops User. G02 CR Doc (BR-CR-279) and G11 "Super Admin, Normal Admin" (BR-ADM-088) give 2 roles. G02 30 Jun lists Admin groups A/B/C (BR-CR-355).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: 3 roles (V2.0, the highest version). However, "Ops User" has no defined permissions anywhere (G11 open question).
- Question to confirm: Which permissions does "Ops User" hold?
- As built (G16): the Control Panel has five built-in roles, Super Admin, Admin, Contributor, Business Viewer and Tech Viewer, plus custom roles (BR-PD-1598 to BR-PD-1603). There is no "Ops User". See C-79.

**D-04 — HTL/HVL thresholds: values, units, cities, inclusivity**
- Sources disagree:
  - Mumbai >5,000 sq ft and Bangalore/Hyderabad >10,000: G02 (BR-CR-261), G05 (BR-MS-176), G10 (BR-KDT-022).
  - Admin-editable per city: G12 (BR-HTL-001), G10 (BR-KDT-128).
  - Generic ">10,000": G11 (BR-ADM-032).
  - ">5,000 sq ft or >20 seats": G08 (BR-PG1-067), G12 (BR-ROL-065).
  - "[XYZ sq ft]": G04 (BR-REQ-136), G09 (BR-PG2-215).
  - "equal to or above": G03 (BR-DQ-048), against ">" elsewhere.
  - Indore is in the 30 Jun HVL list (BR-CR-352) but Tier 2 elsewhere (BR-KDT-029, BR-HTL-007).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: the thresholds are **admin-configurable per city, asset class and size** (G11 V2.0 HVL rules; G12 HTL). Tier 1 is 8 cities and excludes Indore. Mumbai 5k and BLR/HYD 10k are only examples. The default values for the other 6 Tier-1 cities, the seat threshold and inclusivity are **unresolved**.
- Question to confirm: What are the launch default thresholds for each of the 8 Tier-1 cities, is the comparison ">" or "≥", and is there a seat-based HTL threshold?

**D-05 — HVL manual unlock: who, when, to whom**
- Sources disagree: G05 (BR-MS-178) and G10 (BR-KDT-033/034) say the **Admin** unlocks after "3–4 days" and notifies only agents with matching properties. G12 HTL says the Admin unlocks after "**n** days" and the lead shows only in matching agents' Relevancy tab (BR-HTL-003/004). G11 V2.0 says the **Keydemand team** unlocks, notifies normal and KD agents (BR-ADM-037), and has a per-lead "Agent Access" toggle (BR-ADM-038).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: G11 V2.0 (2026-10-09) is the latest: the KD team (with the "Unlock leads" permission) unlocks, using the toggle. The unlock window is **undefined**.
- Question to confirm: Who may unlock an HTL (Admin only, or any KD member), and is there an automatic or recommended window (3–4 days)?

**D-06 — Can the POC / KD team post or edit an enterprise brand's demands?**
- Sources disagree:
  - **Cannot:** G02 Final (BR-CR-139), G08 Enterprise V1.0 Bulk Upload (BR-PG1-103), G10 V2.0 BR 5 (BR-KDT-047), G12 doc 1 and doc 2's KD section (BR-ROL-015, BR-ROL-019).
  - **Can:** G05 V1.0 (BR-MS-186), G08 Enterprise V1.0 Demand Mgmt (BR-PG1-085), G10 V2.0 drill-down (BR-KDT-099), G12 doc 2 Enterprise section (BR-ROL-063).
  - G11 V2.0 says enterprises log in and post using Format auto-fill (G11 note).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **unresolved.** The latest docs (G08, G10, G12 of 6 Oct) each contain both statements.
- Question to confirm: May an assigned POC add, edit or deactivate an enterprise brand's demands on the front end, or only through the Control Panel bulk upload?

**D-07 — Can Retail/F&B brands explore Office properties?**
- Sources disagree: **No Office:** G02 Final (BR-CR-157, BR-CR-172, BR-CR-212). **Office allowed:** G05 V1.0 (BR-MS-160), G08 Enterprise V1.0 (BR-PG1-112) and G09 Retail/F&B V1.0 (BR-PG2-009, BR-PG2-083). None of them allows Managed Space.
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **Office allowed.** The October-dated authoritative page specs are later than the Final sheet of 3 Aug. Doubt: G02 group notes resolve this the other way inside G02 ("Final wins"). That is correct within G02 but superseded across groups.
- Question to confirm: Confirm that Retail/F&B brands (individual and enterprise) can explore Retail, F&B and Office, but not Managed Space.

**D-08 — Office Tenant posting Managed Space; "operators post only Managed Space"**
- Sources disagree:
  - Unconditional: G02 Final (BR-CR-165) and G12 doc 1 (BR-ROL-008).
  - Only if "Also interested in Managed Space" was ticked: G09 Office V1.0 (BR-PG2-153) and G12 doc 2 (BR-ROL-062).
  - Office only; the tick merely alerts the admin team: G05 V1.0 (BR-MS-021, US-001) and G02 CR Doc 13 Jul "Pending Rule" (G02 note).
  - G08 All User Journeys §8 says both (G08 note).
  - "Managed Space operators can post only Managed Space" (BR-CR-165, BR-PG2-199, BR-ROL-008) conflicts with "operators do not log in" (BR-CR-167, BR-PG2-202).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **unresolved.** The latest (G12 doc 2 and G09) say "only if ticked", but G05 V1.0 (8 Oct) says office only. The "operator" wording is probably meant to read "Managed Space occupier/tenant" (G12 note), but that is unclear.
- Question to confirm: If an Office Tenant ticks "Also interested in Managed Office/Space", can they post a Managed Space demand themselves, or is the interest only routed to Keydemand?

**D-09 — Developer and Managed Space Operator login and onboarding**
- Sources disagree:
  - No login; enquiry form; admin onboards within 24 h: G05 V1.0 (BR-MS-022), G08 Landing V1.0 (BR-PG1-004/013), G09 MS V1.0 (BR-PG2-202), G02 Final (BR-CR-167).
  - Developers access dashboards and leads "from the backend": G11 doc 6 (BR-ADM-097).
  - Developers see projects on their dashboard: G06 (BR-FLD-174).
  - "List a Project" with a registration form via a radio button: G02 29 Jul (BR-CR-329).
  - Landing V1.0: the phone + OTP enquiry returns a registered number to the dashboard (G08 note).
  - G05 Phase 2 US-042 has a Developer Dashboard.
- Current resolution under the authority rules: G05 V1.0 says no front-end login, with projects added by Admin. But G11 doc 6 and G06 (BR-FLD-174) have developers accessing dashboards and leads.
- Question to confirm: In Phase 1, do Developers and MSOs have any login (even read-only to their profile and RM), or are they enquiry-form-only?

**D-10 — Listing moderation before going live**
- Sources disagree:
  - Pending → admin approval: G04 STORIES (BR-REQ-186/188/190), G05 Phase 2 US-055 (BR-MS-261).
  - "Admins … approve or moderate listings": G12 (BR-ROL-024).
  - G04 Oct 2 notification says "posted successfully… now live" (G04 note). G05 V1.0 has no gate. G11 V2.0 approval applies only to bulk uploads (BR-ADM-070).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **no pre-moderation** for user-posted listings in Phase 1 (Oct 2 and V1.0). Moderation is Phase 2, apart from bulk-upload approval. This needs confirmation because of G12.
- Question to confirm: Do user-posted properties and demands go live instantly in Phase 1, with moderation only after the fact?

**D-11 — Demand inactivity: 60 days vs 90 days vs a 3-month check**
- Sources disagree:
  - Auto-"Inactive" after 60 days: G04 Access Permissions (BR-REQ-165), G05 V1.0 (BR-MS-185), G06 (BR-FLD-157), G08 Journey (BR-PG1-245), G11 V2.0 for bulk (BR-ADM-071), G12 (BR-ROL-059).
  - A 90-day "still available?" digest: G04 Oct 2 (BR-REQ-108).
  - An "Active Status check every 3 months": G09 (BR-PG2-056, BR-PG2-130, BR-PG2-188) and G05 (BR-MS-185).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: G04 resolved this in-group as "90-day prompt; 60-day unconfirmed". But G05 V1.0 (8 Oct) and G11 V2.0 (9 Oct) still apply 60-day expiry. **Needs business decision.** The two could coexist (60-day expiry plus a 90-day digest for older listings), but no doc says so.
- Question to confirm: Do demands auto-expire at 60 days, or only get a "still available?" prompt at 90 days / 3 months?

**D-12 — Legal entity name**
- Sources disagree: entity "Keydemand" (BR-CR-233) vs "Keyproperty" (BR-CR-262, BR-CR-215), all in G02.
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **unresolved.** G02 gives both names.
- Question to confirm: What legal entity name goes on the T&C and Privacy Policy?

**D-13 — Age gate and the consent checkbox**
- Sources disagree:
  - "No separate DOB field or checkbox": G02 (BR-CR-041).
  - Exact 18+ phrase "and a tick": G02 (BR-CR-045).
  - Mandatory T&C + "18 and above" checkbox: G05 V1.0 (BR-MS-012). G02 29 Jul: implemented.
- Current resolution under the authority rules: an 18+ checkbox exists (G05 V1.0; G02 29 Jul, implemented).
- Question to confirm: Is registration gated by an 18+ / T&C checkbox?

**D-14 — Email at registration and domain validation**
- Sources disagree:
  - "Remove email field completely": G02 Final (BR-CR-044).
  - Mandatory for Brands/Tenants, optional for Agents: G02 (BR-CR-047), G05 (BR-MS-063, BR-MS-123).
  - Domain validation (block @gmail): G05 V1.0 (BR-MS-123) vs "NOT enforced" in G02 Final (G02 note).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: mandatory for entities, optional for Agents (G05 V1.0 is later). Domain blocking is **unresolved**, because G05 V1.0 (8 Oct) is later than G02 Final (3 Aug) and re-asserts blocking.
- Question to confirm: Is "Official Email ID" mandatory for Brands/Tenants, and are generic domains (gmail etc.) blocked?

**D-15 — Refunds and mid-cycle cancellation**
- Sources disagree:
  - No refund on city cancellation: G05 (BR-MS-095), G08 V1.1 (BR-PG1-168).
  - Cancellations take effect next billing cycle: G12 (BR-ROL-040). G08 Journey: changes reflect on next month's bill (G08 note).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: no refund on city cancellation (G05, G08). The effective date of cancellation (immediate vs next cycle) is **unresolved**.
- Question to confirm: When an agent removes a city mid-cycle, does access end immediately or at cycle end?
- As built (G16): removing coverage is queued for the next cycle; an agent cannot remove everything and must cancel instead (BR-PD-0487); the plan auto-renews with the queued adds and removals (BR-PD-0491).

**D-16 — Media size limits**
- Sources disagree:
  - Images <2 MB, video <5 MB: G04 Oct 2 (BR-REQ-013), G06 Sep 16 sheets (BR-FLD-036).
  - Images 5 MB, video 15 MB: G05 V1.0 (BR-MS-125), G04 "All Fields" block.
  - 5 MB ≥300 ppi, video 20 MB: G06 persona doc and G08 Journey (BR-PG1-226).
  - PDF 2 MB vs 5 MB (BR-REQ-034, BR-FLD-065).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **unresolved.** G05 V1.0 (8 Oct) is later than the G06 sheets (16 Sep), but G04 Oct 2 (modified 10 Oct) agrees with G06.

G04 filters use "Received / Applied / Not Applicable" (G04 open question).

- Sources disagree: soft-delete keeping inventory (G05 V1.0, BR-MS-049) vs mandatory handover to another KD user first (G10 V2.0, BR-KDT-006; G11 V2.0, BR-ADM-016/017).

**D-21 — Managed Space minimum seats vs Enterprise trigger**
- Sources disagree: the Managed Space demand form accepts "only more than 20 seats" (G04, BR-REQ-066; G06, BR-FLD-029), yet requests >20 seats are routed to the Enterprise funnel (G05, BR-MS-166; G12, BR-ROL-066; G08, BR-PG1-067).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **unresolved.** Taken together, these rules would make every individual Managed Space demand an Enterprise lead.
- Question to confirm: What is the minimum seat count for an individual Managed Space demand, and above what seat count does it become an Enterprise lead?
- As built (G16): the minimum is 20 seats ("Enter 20 or more seats") on every Managed Space demand, individual and enterprise (BR-PD-1077, BR-PD-1103, BR-PD-1110). See C-82.

**D-22 — Agent free trial: 1 listing AND 1 demand, or 1 listing OR 1 demand**
- Sources disagree:
  - "or": G05 (BR-MS-017), G08 All User Journeys (BR-PG1-261), G04 Access Permissions (BR-REQ-156).
  - "and": G05 (BR-MS-089), G12 (BR-ROL-034), G08 Landing V1.0 (G08 note).
  - "1 listing maximum": G08 V1.1.
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **unresolved.** The latest docs (G08 Landing 15 Oct "and"; G08 All User Journeys 6 Oct "or") disagree.
- Question to confirm: Does a non-subscribed agent get one free property listing and one free demand, or one of either?

G05/G08/G09 map expiry to "Rejected" (BR-MS-181, BR-PG1-146, BR-PG2-032), while G11 has "Expired".
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **unresolved.**
- Question to confirm: What is the single status list for contact/image/project leads, and does an expired request show as "Rejected" or "Expired"?

**D-24 — OTP length**
- Sources disagree: 4 digits (G08 Journey, BR-PG1-192; G04 STORIES US-003) vs "4 or 6" (G04, BR-REQ-149) vs 6 digits (G05 V1.0, BR-MS-061, BR-MS-051).
- Current resolution under the authority rules: **6 digits** (G05 V1.0 is the latest).
- Question to confirm: Confirm that the login OTP is 6 digits for all apps.
- As built (G16): the one-time code is 6 digits, with resend after 30 seconds (BR-PD-0219, BR-PD-0266).

### Glossary

| Term | Meaning on Keydemand (cite source) | Also called / old name |
|---|---|---|
| Keydemand V2 Phase 1 | The release covered by this KB: Web, Mobile (Android/iOS via one TypeScript codebase) and Admin apps (G12 BR-ROL-001) | V2 |
| User Portal | The front-end for agents, brands, tenants, KD team (G05 BR-MS-001) | Front end |
| Control Panel | The back-end admin console for user management, bulk uploads, subscriptions, HVL configuration; restricted to 4–5 core people (G05 BR-MS-001/003; G11 BR-ADM-003; G02 BR-CR-003) | Admin panel, Admin Console, Keydemand-Admin |
| Property | A supply listing (office, retail, F&B unit) posted by an agent or KD team (G06 Property & Project Input Fields; G04 P&P) | Listing |
| Demand | A space requirement posted by a brand, tenant, agent or KD team; front-end users cannot search demands (G05 BR-MS-159; G06 Demand Input fields) | Requirement, lead (when routed) |
| Project | A developer or Managed Space Operator development/centre, added only by Admin from the backend (G04 BR-REQ-045/048; G10 BR-KDT-136) | Developer project, Managed centre |
| Asset class | Retail, F&B, Office, Managed Space (Flex = Phase 2) (G06 BR-FLD-072; G04 BR-REQ-043) | Property type |
| Agent | External broker who lists properties/demands; free trial then subscription (G05 BR-MS-089; G08 BR-PG1-261) | Property Agent (renamed), Broker, Channel Partner |
| Trial Plan / Pro Member | Labels for unsubscribed vs paying agents (G05 BR-MS-101) | Free Plan; "Broker"/"Agent" labels deprecated |
| Brand – Retail | Occupier brand posting Retail demands only; 3 free demands (G09 persona table; G05 BR-MS-160) | Retail Brand |
| Brand – F&B | Occupier brand posting F&B demands only; 3 free demands (G09; G05 BR-MS-160) | F&B Brand |
| Office Tenant | Occupier posting Office demands; 1 free demand; 5 contact views (G09 BR-PG2-153/164) | Tenant (renamed), Office Occupier |
| Managed Space Tenant | Occupier seeking managed office seats; 1 demand; demands visible only to KD (G09 MS V1.0; G04 BR-REQ-068) | Managed Space Occupier (`managed_space_occupier`), Managed Office Tenant |
| Managed Space Operator (MSO) | Supply-side operator of managed centres; no self-login in Phase 1 rules; onboarded by Admin, like a Developer (G02 BR-CR-167; G09 BR-PG2-202; G12 BR-ROL-025) — see C-32 | Operator, Managed Office Operator |
| Developer | Builder whose projects are uploaded by Admin; enquiry form only (G05 BR-MS-022) | — |
| Enterprise | Brand/tenant account upgraded by Keydemand (after free quota, size threshold or self-selection); assigned POC; Formats; bulk upload (G03 BR-DQ-029; G08 BR-PG1-066/114; G12 BR-ROL-068) | Enterprise Solution, Enterprise user |
| Individual | Non-enterprise brand/tenant account (G11 permission matrix; G06 BR-FLD-119) | — |
| Formats | Admin-defined enterprise templates (fixed specs; only City/Location vary) (G11 BR-ADM-064/072) | Brand Formats |
| Keydemand Team (KD team) | Internal users onboarded only via backend, mobile + OTP login; can explore demands, post all asset classes, bypass paywalls (G10 BR-KDT-001/002/012; G12 BR-ROL-017/018/021) | KD member, Keydemand user |
| POC (Point of Contact) | KD member assigned to an enterprise account per city; "POC" brand-side, "Account Handler" backend (G05 BR-MS-069; G08 BR-PG1-092) | Account Handler, RM, TM |
| RM (Relationship Manager) | Internal term only; must not be shown to clients (G10 BR-KDT-062) | POC, Account Handler |
| BRM | Broker Relationship Manager: KD persona with read-only oversight of all subscribed external brokers (G02 BR-CR-198) | BD broker monitoring (G12 BR-ROL-022) |
| Super Admin | Control Panel role with full access; only one who can delete other admins (G11 matrix rows 2–3) | — |
| Admin | Control Panel role restricted to granted permissions (G11 matrix) | Standard Admin, Normal Admin |
| Ops User | Third Phase 1 admin role named but undefined (G11 BR-ADM-004) | — |
| HTL / HVL | High Ticket / High Value Lead: demand above a per-city/asset-class size threshold in a Tier-1 city; hidden from external agents and routed to the KD team (G12 BR-HTL-001/002; G10 BR-KDT-022; G11 BR-ADM-032) | High Ticket Leads, High Value Ticket, "Requirements more than 5K" (G03) |
| Tier 1 / Tier 2 (HTL) | Tier 1 = Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Coimbatore, Pune, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Delhi (HTL applies); Tier 2 (e.g. Jaipur, Indore) open to all (G12 BR-HTL-006/007; G10 BR-KDT-028/029) | — |
| Manual unlock | Releasing an HTL to the agent relevancy pool (G12 BR-HTL-003/004; G11 BR-ADM-037/038) | Agent Access toggle |
| Massive Demand Bypass | Agent-posted demand above threshold (e.g. >10,000 sq ft BLR) stays visible to agents (G05 BR-MS-177) | — |
| Metro / Non-metro / ROI / Pan India | Subscription coverage tiers: per-city Metro (₹1000) or Non-Metro (₹750), Rest of India, Pan India (₹5000) (G04 BR-REQ-001–005; G05 BR-MS-084/090) | Rest of Cities |
| Bundle | Subscription asset grouping: (Retail & F&B) and (Office) (G05 BR-MS-086; G08 BR-PG1-163) | Asset group |
| Contact unlock | Revealing a hidden contact number, subject to free limits or subscription (G05 BR-MS-028) | View Phone Number, Connects, contact reveal |
| Two-way reveal | When a user views a number, both parties receive each other's details via WhatsApp; no approval needed (G09 BR-PG2-161; G12 BR-ROL-009/010) | — |
| Contact request | Agent's request to connect on a brand's demand, needing brand Accept/Reject (G09 BR-PG2-031/032) — window see D-01 | Request Contact, connection request |
| Image request | Request to see hidden property images; never expires (G05 BR-MS-033; G08 BR-PG1-139) | Request for Images |
| Relevancy | Automated demand↔property/project matching with field weights per asset class (G07 BR-REL-001–019) | Matches, relevant demands/properties |
| Similar properties / projects | Related listings on a property/project page; similar projects Phase 2 (G07 BR-REL-021/022/026) | — |
| Carpet area vs built-up area | Carpet must be ≤ Built-up (G02 BR-CR-016); built-up required on Office, deleted on Retail/F&B forms (G06 BR-FLD-059/068); Efficiency = carpet ÷ super built-up (G06 BR-FLD-082) | Super built-up |
| OC | Occupancy Certificate: property "OC Status" (4 values, see D-17); demand "OC Required" Yes/No (G05 BR-MS-169) | OC available (V1) |
| RERA | Real-estate regulator registration number; optional at project level (G05 BR-MS-194); shown only for Agent/Developer (G04 BR-REQ-055) | Rera ID |
| Standard / Premium / Exclusive | Project categories; Premium = paid, city-specific slots; Exclusive = mandated to Keydemand (G05 BR-MS-197; G12 BR-ROL-023) | Regular / Sponsored / Exclusive (old); Common Project (G11) |
| Microsite | City- or asset-class-specific landing area for occupiers (G09 persona table) | — |
| Enterprise Solution | Upsell/onboarding path for brands/tenants to enterprise (G08 BR-PG1-066) | — |
| Leads / Enquiries | Leads = inbound (phone viewed, contact/image requests); Enquiries = outbound (projects enquired, numbers viewed, images requested) (G09 shared rules; G05 BR-MS-188) | "Leads received" (deprecated), contact inquiries |
| Show Interest | CTA to enquire on a project (G09 shared rules) | Enquire Now (old) |
| Bulk upload | Excel/CSV upload of listings/formats via Control Panel; ≤5 MB / 2,000 rows; approval before live (G11 BR-ADM-068/070; G06 BR-FLD-100) | — |
| Daily digest / daily cap | Bundled once-a-day notification; per-user limit on sends (G12 BR-NTF-011/014) | Daily Summary |
| Transactional vs promotional | Transactional WhatsApp (leads, relevancy) cannot be disabled; promotional can (G05 BR-MS-076; G06 BR-FLD-116) | — |
| CR | Change Request: business-rule changes logged in the CR register (G02 doc table) | — |
| UAT | User Acceptance Testing by the Keydemand business team (G02 BR-CR-206) | — |
| Grievance Officer | Legally required contact for complaints/takedown (G02 BR-CR-031) | — |
| Keyproperty | Candidate legal entity name (G02 BR-CR-262) — see D-12 | Keydemand |
| Interakt / MSG91 / Razorpay | WhatsApp/email notifications; SMS OTP; payments (G02 BR-CR-214) | — |

**Conventions used in this section**
- BR numbering: BR-CR-001…205 are the rows of the Final sheet (authoritative register). BR-CR-206 onward are rules found in the other docs that are **not** already stated identically in the Final sheet (new rules, extra detail, or a different value). Where a doc repeats a Final-sheet rule word-for-word or near-verbatim, it is cross-referenced ("also stated: BR-CR-xxx") instead of being re-numbered.
- BR-CR-376…409 are the post-production change requests of the November 2026 sprint sheet (added 2026-11-06). That sheet has its own local Rule IDs (BR-001…BR-016); they are quoted as "sheet BR-0NN".
- Comments in Google Docs are shown inline as `⟦comment <id> start⟧ … ⟦comment <id> end — <author> (<date>, <status>): "<text>"⟧`.
- Struck-through text in the source is shown as `~~text~~ *(struck through in source)*`.
- No passwords, OTPs, keys or tokens appear in any of these documents; nothing was redacted.

##### Tab "Overall Milestones"
**Keydemand V2 - Phase 1 | Delivery Plan & Timeline**

This plan delivers the full Phase-1 change-request & enhancements along with pending workitems for Keydemand V2 across two modules - the User Portal (one web + mobile app, shared codebase) and the Admin Control Panel - together with all the behind-the-scenes engineering (APIs, database, data migration from the current V1 system, and hosting). The work builds on the existing V2 foundation, is delivered in short sprints, and is tested continuously so we reach a stable, business-approved launch on 6 November 2026.

**At a glance**
| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kickoff | 6 July 2026 (Monday) |
| Go-Live (Production) | 6 November 2026 (Friday) |
| Total duration | ~18 weeks (about 4.5 months) |
| Delivery approach | Agile - complete design up front, short build sprints, continuous QA, business sign-off before launch |
| Products | User Portal (web + mobile, one shared codebase) and the Admin Control Panel |
| Scope | All Phase-1 CRs: user journeys, Keydemand Team persona, High-Value-Lead engine, Admin Control Panel, data migration |

**Key Milestones & Dates**
| Milestone | Target date | Week | What it means |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kickoff | 06-Jul-2026 | W1 | Programme starts; requirements & full platform design underway. |
| Complete Platform Design Sign-off | 17-Jul-2026 | W2 | All screens (web/mobile/admin), data model and API contracts agreed. |
| Sprint 1 Complete - Foundation | 07-Aug-2026 | W5 | Global rules, registration/login and landing pages in Dev. |
| Sprint 2 Complete - Admin Control Panel | 28-Aug-2026 | W8 | Admin user management, configuration & bulk uploads in Dev. |
| Sprint 3 Complete - User Journeys | 11-Sep-2026 | W10 | Agent, Subscription, Brand/Enterprise, Access Matrix, Managed-Space in Dev. |
| DEV Complete (Feature-Complete) | 25-Sep-2026 | W12 | Keydemand Team persona, High-Value-Leads, Notifications & Mobile all built. |
| Migration Validated + SIT/QA Complete | 16-Oct-2026 | W15 | V1 data migrated & all three surfaces tested in SIT. |
| UAT Sign-off | 30-Oct-2026 | W17 | Business team accepts the platform. |
| Go-Live (Production) | 06-Nov-2026 | W18 | Platform live; V1 users migrated with 3-month free access. |

**Team & responsibilities**
| Team member | Role | Responsible for |
|---|---|---|
| Sathish(Lead) | Backend & DevOps | All server-side APIs, database & schema, data migration (V1 -> V2), hosting/environments (Dev, SIT, UAT, Production) and security. |
| Krishna | Frontend | The User Portal (web + mobile from ONE shared codebase - build once, verify the mobile screens) and the Admin Control Panel. |
| John & Patrik | Quality Assurance | Independent end-to-end testing of all three surfaces (Web, Mobile, Admin), the V1 -> V2 migration, and support during business UAT. |
| Keydemand Business Team | Acceptance | Validates the platform against real business scenarios during UAT and gives the final go-ahead for launch. |

**Who uses which product**
| Product | Users |
|---|---|
| User Portal (Web + Mobile) | Property Agents, Brands & Tenants (individual + enterprise), Developers/Operators, and Keydemand personas - the Keydemand Team AND the Broker Relationship Manager (BRM), a Keydemand role that oversees all external subscribed brokers and their metrics to resolve their concerns. All of these are personas INSIDE the User Portal, NOT separate apps. |
| Admin Control Panel | Only the small Keydemand Admin team (4-5 core users) - for user onboarding, bulk uploads, pricing & city configuration, and High-Value-Lead rules. |

**How we work (in plain terms)**
- >> We start from the platform already built in V2, the pending work includes the mix of new features along with enhancements plus Admin module
- >> We complete the full platform design first (all screens, data model and API contracts) before heavy build begins.
- >> We build the Admin Control Panel early (Sprint 2): it configures platform-wide settings (users, pricing, High-Value-Lead rules), which lets the user-app features be developed and tested end-to-end.
- >> The Web and Mobile apps share one codebase, so features are built once and the mobile screens are double-checked - not built twice.
- >> Backend, Frontend and Testing run in parallel every sprint; each sprint ends with working software the business can preview.
- >> Nothing goes live until the Keydemand business team signs off in UAT.
- >> One week of database-schema work now runs in parallel with backend development, so Go-Live moves one week earlier - to 6 November 2026.

##### Tab "Delivery Tracker"
**Delivery Plan - Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)**
We finish the complete platform design first, then build in four sprints - starting with the Admin Control Panel (which controls platform-wide configuration) so the user journeys can be built and tested seamlessly - followed by migration, testing, business acceptance and launch.

| # | Stage | Dates | What happens (plain English) | Who | Outcome / Milestone |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Requirements & Complete Platform Design | 06 Jul - 17 Jul 2026 | Finalise the detailed requirements from the CR list and complete the design of the WHOLE platform - all screens (web/mobile/admin), the data model and the API contracts - so build runs smoothly. | Whole team | Complete design sign-off |
| 2 | Build Sprint 1 - Foundation | 20 Jul - 07 Aug 2026 | Shared platform base: global changes (renaming, field rules, validations), the new registration & login experience, and the public landing & discovery pages. | Sathish + Krishna | Foundation working in Dev |
| 3 | Build Sprint 2 - Admin Control Panel | 10 Aug - 28 Aug 2026 | The Admin Control Panel built early: user onboarding & management, subscription/pricing & city configuration, High-Value-Lead rules, enterprise brand & format setup, bulk uploads, roles. This controls the platform so user journeys build & test seamlessly. | Sathish + Krishna | Admin Control Panel working in Dev |
| 4 | Build Sprint 3 - User Journeys & Subscriptions | 31 Aug - 11 Sep 2026 | User Portal journeys that consume the Admin configuration: Property-Agent flow & dashboard, subscriptions & payments, Brand/Tenant/Enterprise journeys, the asset-class access matrix and Managed-Space. | Sathish + Krishna | User journeys working in Dev |
| 5 | Build Sprint 4 - Keydemand Team, High-Value Leads & Mobile | 14 Sep - 25 Sep 2026 | The Keydemand Team persona inside the User Portal (dashboards, listings, enterprise accounts), the Broker Relationship Manager (BRM) view over all external subscribed brokers, the High-Value-Lead routing engine, notifications, mobile-screen finalisation and compliance items. | Sathish + Krishna | Feature-complete (DEV Complete) |
| 6 | Data Migration & System Testing (SIT) | 28 Sep - 16 Oct 2026 | Migrate all existing V1 users & content into V2, and have QA test all three surfaces (Web, Mobile, Admin) end-to-end plus the migration in the SIT environment. | Sathish + John & Patrik | Tested, migration-validated build |
| 7 | User Acceptance Testing (UAT) | 19 Oct - 30 Oct 2026 | The Keydemand business team (with QA) validates the platform against real business scenarios and signs off. | Business + John & Patrik | Client UAT sign-off |
| 8 | Go-Live | 02 Nov - 06 Nov 2026 | Final production cutover, V1 users migrated with 3 months complimentary access, and the platform goes live. | Sathish | Live in Production - 6 Nov |

#### Business rules extracted
Rules BR-CR-001 … BR-CR-205 = one per populated Business Rule row of the main tab, in sheet order (source wording, Business Rule Type in brackets).

- **BR-CR-001** — [Empty Fields] Any field left empty should be hidden from the UI in view mode(non mandatory fields) _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 1, row 3; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-002** — [Renaming] Rename 'Agent' to 'Property Agent' and 'Tenant' to 'Office Tenant' and Managed Space Tenant globally. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 2, row 4; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-003** — [Control Panel Access] The Control Panel is exclusively for user management, bulk uploads, platform oversight, and configuring high-value leads, and must only be accessible to 4-5 core users. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 3, row 5; Module: AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-004** — [V2 Phase 1 Roles] For the initial launch, enforce strictly three primary administrative roles in the Control Panel: 'Super Admin',  'Admin' and 'Ops User'. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 4, row 6; Module: Admin App)_
- **BR-CR-005** — [Super Admin Privileges] The Super Admin role must possess the highest system privileges, including the specific authority to delete or remove other Admins from the system. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 5, row 7; Module: Admin App)_
- **BR-CR-006** — [Dynamic Role Creation] The system must include functionality allowing the core admin team to dynamically create new internal users and assign their access permissions across the platform. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 6, row 8; Module: Admin App)_
- **BR-CR-007** — [Admin Login Protocol] Admin account creation requires a name, email ID, and permissions set. Login operates via email and password. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 7, row 9; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-008** — [Password Complexity] Passwords must contain at least 6 characters, including one uppercase letter, one number, and one special character. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 8, row 10; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-009** — [Session Timeout] Admin sessions must automatically time out after 15 minutes of inactivity for security purposes. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 9, row 11; Module: Admin App)_
- **BR-CR-010** — [Automated Migration] All active V1 users must be automatically migrated to the new V2 platform. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 10, row 12; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-011** — [Complimentary Access] At the time of go-live, the Admin team must manually use the Control Panel to assign 3 months of complimentary Pan-India access to all migrated V1 users. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 11, row 13; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-012** — [Privacy Policy Action] The Privacy Policy must immediately append a conditional scope clause into the Privacy Policy detailing potential future chatbot integrations. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 12, row 14; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-013** — [Validation Logic] Trigger an explicit error for incomplete email addresses or mandatory fields. The system must visually highlight the missing section and guide the user to it. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 13, row 15; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-014** — [Redirection] The interface should automatically redirect the user to the precise location of any missing fields. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 14, row 16; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-015** — [PDF Download] Implement the missing functionality where we allow users to download a PDF of their own 'My Listings'. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 15, row 17; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-016** — [Area Validation] Carpet Area must strictly be less than or equal to the Built-up Area. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 16, row 18; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-017** — [Filters & Sorting] Implement comprehensive filters (e.g., City) and sorting options (e.g., 'Most Demands,' 'Most Properties Posted,' 'Most Leads Received') on the dashboard to allow effective monitoring. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 17, row 19; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-018** — [Field Editability] Ensure that 'yes' fields remain editable by users even after a response has been received. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 18, row 20; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-019** — [Demand Posting] Expand the 'other interested location' options to allow users to input at least 3 additional localities. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 19, row 21; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-020** — [OC Supply Standardization] To prevent contradictions in the relevance Machine Learning (ML) models, the 'OC Status' fields across all property and project backend sheets must be unified to exactly three terms: 'Available', 'Not available', and 'Under construction'. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 20, row 22; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-021** — [Draft Auto-Save] The system must automatically save a draft of a property or demand listing every 30 seconds during the posting flow. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 21, row 23; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-022** — [Brand Image Display] If a brand logo/image is uploaded in the backend, it must display as the demand image. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 22, row 24; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-023** — [Reference Images] Show sample reference images during the image upload step so users understand what kind of photos to upload. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 23, row 25; Module: —)_
- **BR-CR-024** — [User Permissions] Grant users the ability to modify all fields except for the core City and Location parameters. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 24, row 26; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-025** — [Image Shuffling] For demands without brand logos, the UI should shuffle between a pool of five high-quality asset-class images to maintain a dynamic look. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 25, row 27; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-026** — [Locked Fields] Ensure Asset Class, Transaction Type, City, and Location remain permanently locked. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 26, row 28; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-027** — [Unlocked Fields] Unlock 'Other interested locations' and 'Possession needed' fields so they can be edited after initial submission _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 27, row 29; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-028** — [Property Cards Display] Listing Title: Display the Project Name, if available. If absent, use the descriptive format: [Store Type] [Asset Class] Property. Posted By: Display the name of the specific Agent. If posted by the Keydemand team, display 'Keydemand'. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 28, row 30; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-029** — [Demand Cards Display] Categories: Retail Demand, Office Demand, Managed Space Demand, F&B Demand. Posted By: Display the specific Brand, Tenant, or Agent name. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 29, row 31; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-030** — [RERA Numbers] Add a mandatory field to capture RERA numbers, restricted strictly to the project level. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 30, row 32; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-031** — [Grievance Officer] Appoint and clearly display the contact details for a Grievance Officer, satisfying both DPDP and GDPR mandates. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 31, row 33; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-032** — [Event Tracking] Implement strict event tracking to monitor user behaviour when they encounter hidden images to support A/B testing and funnel analysis. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 32, row 34; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-033** — [Privacy Policy] A conditional scope clause detailing potential future chatbot integrations must be added to the Privacy Policy immediately. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 33, row 35; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-034** — [Leads Renaming] Rename the existing 'contact inquiries' section to 'leads' to streamline the interface.Inquiries + Image Requests = Lead). _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 34, row 36; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-035** — [Legacy Data] Recognise that any lead counts currently visible are legacy data, as the system lacks an active mechanism to increment them. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 35, row 37; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-036** — [Attribution Tracking] User acquisition sources (e.g., Organic vs. Paid) will be tracked using the user's phone number as the primary source of truth. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Applies to all user journeys(Generic) › Sno 36, row 38; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-037** — [CTA Restrictions] Ensure unregistered users are prompted to register only when clicking actionable elements like 'View Phone Number' or 'Contact Us'. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Landing Page and Login Flows › Sno 37, row 40; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-038** — [Request a Callback] Add a 'Request a callback' button alongside the 'Book a demo' option in About Keydemand video section. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Landing Page and Login Flows › Sno 38, row 41; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-039** — [Book a Demo] Change 'Book a demo' text to 'Send an inquiry' in the About section. Add two provided logos to the client marquee. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Landing Page and Login Flows › Sno 39, row 42; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_
- **BR-CR-040** — [OTP Wait Timer] The system must strictly enforce a 30-second cooldown period before a user can request an OTP resend. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Landing Page and Login Flows › Sno 40, row 43; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-041** — [Compliance & Verification] Age verification (18+) is managed via the standard Terms & Conditions agreement. No separate DOB field or checkbox is required in the registration flow. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Landing Page and Login Flows › Sno 41, row 44; Module: —)_
- **BR-CR-042** — [Abandoned Session] If a user successfully verifies their mobile number via OTP but abandons the registration process before completing their profile, the backend must instantly capture and log that mobile number as an actionable lead. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Landing Page and Login Flows › Sno 42, row 45; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_
- **BR-CR-043** — [Resuming Registration] If a user who previously abandoned their registration returns and enters their verified mobile number, the system must bypass the initial verification steps and direct them straight to the profile setup page. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Landing Page and Login Flows › Sno 43, row 46; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_

- **BR-CR-048** — [Email Field Validation] Strict domain-level validation (such as actively blocking generic domains like '@gmail.com') is NOT enforced in the system. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Landing Page and Login Flows › Sno 48, row 51; Module: WebApp + MobileApp + AdminApp)_

- **BR-CR-051** — [Property Detail Access] Implement functionality allowing unregistered users to view property details by default. _(§ Final › 'Phase 1 - CRs and New Business' › Landing Page and Login Flows › Sno 51, row 54; Module: WebApp + MobileApp)_

- **BR-CR-055** — [Landing Page City Tabs] Remove static city tabs from the exclusive projects section.
