###### 2\. Core Feature Catalog

###### Module A — Sign-in & Accounts

**Purpose:** Let anyone join with a phone number, pick a role, and start. No passwords for end users.

| Feature Name | Deduced Business Purpose | User Trigger / Input | Expected System Outcome |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Phone sign-in | Frictionless access, no passwords | Phone number, then one-time code | Signed in. New numbers continue to role selection. |
| Role selection and registration | Put each user on the right journey | Choose role, fill the profile | Account created. Developers and operators are filed as leads instead. |
| Agent profile | Build broker credibility and set coverage | Photo, name, email, bio, states, cities, asset classes | Profile saved. Email is optional; there is no email-verification step. |
| Brand profile | Capture what a brand is looking for | Brand name, asset class, cities | A company and brand record are created behind the scenes. |
| Self-service account controls | Let individuals pause or leave | Deactivate, reactivate, request deletion | Listings hide or return. Enterprise accounts must go through Keydemand. |
| Session security | Keep accounts safe | Sign-out or inactivity | Short-lived sessions that refresh quietly. |

###### Module B — Property Listings (Supply)

**Purpose:** Let agents and Keydemand publish space, with the right audience and edit protections.

| Feature Name | Deduced Business Purpose | User Trigger / Input | Expected System Outcome |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Post a property | Supply for the marketplace | Shared form for all four asset classes | Saved. Goes live immediately or waits for approval, depending on environment. |
| Save as draft | Don't lose half-filled forms | Leave the form mid-way | Draft kept on the account. |
| Edit a property | Keep listings accurate | Edit form | Updates. After the first enquiry, four identity fields lock (asset class, transaction type, city, location). |
| "Who can see this" | Control which groups see a listing | Tick groups (Keydemand posts only) | Applies to browse, search, detail, documents and contact reveal. |
| Hide specific photos | Protect sensitive images | Mark photos hidden | Only the owner, Keydemand and approved requesters see them. |
| Mark sold or rented, deactivate | Keep the marketplace fresh | Status change | Leaves the marketplace. Open enquiries close. |
| Download PDF | Shareable brochure | Download button | Branded PDF, cached for repeat use. |
| Property leads view | Track interest in a listing | Open "leads" on a property | List of contact requests and image requests. |

###### Module C — Demands / Requirements (Demand Side)

**Purpose:** Let brands, tenants and agents state what they need, in a structured way.

| Feature Name | Deduced Business Purpose | User Trigger / Input | Expected System Outcome |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Post a demand | Capture a requirement | Shared form: asset class, city, localities, area, possession, class-specific needs | Saved and matched to listings. Free limits enforced by persona. |
| Edit, deactivate, fulfil | Keep requirements current | Status change | Fulfilled or inactive demands leave matching. |
| High-value routing | Keep large requirements with Keydemand | Automatic on posting | Qualifying demands hide from agents and go to the Keydemand team. |
| Audience control | Decide who sees a demand | Keydemand posts only | Other posters' demands are visible to agents and Keydemand by default. |
| Demand PDF | Shareable requirement summary | Download button | PDF generated. |

###### Module D — Discovery: Search, Explore & Matching

**Purpose:** Help users find the right listings fast.

| Feature Name | Deduced Business Purpose | User Trigger / Input | Expected System Outcome |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Home feed | Entry point by city | Choose city | Featured, new and relevant listings. |
| Combined search | One search across properties and projects | Text, filters, listing ID or old v1 listing number | Ranked results. Demands appear for Keydemand staff only. |
| Explore properties and projects | Browse with filters | Asset class, budget, area, city | Paged results, newest or most-leads first. |
| **% Match score** | Show fit between a demand and a listing | Automatic | Percentage per pair, best first. Below 50% is hidden. |
| Similar properties | Keep users browsing | Open a property | Related listings shown. |
| Relevant demands for a property | Agents see who might want their space | Open own property | Matching demands listed (agents see only demands they are allowed to). |
| Daily digest | Bring users back | 18:00 India time | Roll-up of new matches. |
| City and region coverage | Group neighbouring cities | Choose city | Regions such as NCR, Mumbai region, Goa and Pune region widen the pool. |
| Photo visibility rules | Reward sign-up | Signed out vs in | Signed-out visitors see no photos. |

**How the match score works (current version):**

- **Hard filters first:** Both listings must be live, same transaction (lease or sale), compatible asset class, same city, within 3 km of a requested location, and within 75–125% of the requested area.  
- **Weighted scoring:** Each asset class weights what matters most. For example, Office is 40% location and 40% area. Retail splits location, area, ceiling height and floor at 20% each. Price is not scored.  
- **Cut-off:** Pairs below 50% are not shown. Demands no longer expire.

###### Module E — Enquiries & Contact Reveal

**Purpose:** Turn interest into a conversation, and charge for it fairly.

| Feature Name | Deduced Business Purpose | User Trigger / Input | Expected System Outcome |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Send an enquiry | Express interest in a property, demand or project | Enquiry button | Recipient notified. Expires after 72 hours if unanswered. |
| Accept or reject | Owner controls who gets contact details | Respond to an enquiry | On accept, both parties see each other's contact. |
| Request hidden photos | Gate sensitive images | "Request images" | Owner approves, and the requester sees all photos from then on. |
| Reveal contact number | The core paywall | "View number" | Instant for property and non-brand demands. Brand demands need the brand's approval. |
| Project "Show Interest" | Developer lead capture | Button on a project | Lead goes to the project's Keydemand account manager. |
| Received and sent tabs | Manage the pipeline | Dashboard | Filter by phone requests, image requests and status. |

###### Module F — Subscriptions & Payments (Agents)

**Purpose:** Monetise agent supply and contact reveal.

| Feature Name | Deduced Business Purpose | User Trigger / Input | Expected System Outcome |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Price quote | Transparent pricing before login | Pick cities and packages | Total with GST shown. |
| Package purchase | Unlock posting and reveals per city | Select cities and a package, pay | Coverage active for 30 days. |
| Add coverage mid-cycle | Grow without waiting | Add a city or package | Charge pro-rated to the current cycle. |
| My Plan | Self-service visibility | Open the plan page | Coverage, renewal date, invoices. |
| Invoice PDF | Accounting | Download | GST invoice. |
| Auto-reconciliation | Never lose a paid order | Automatic, every 30 minutes | Missed payments are settled. |
| Expiry reminders | Reduce churn | Automatic | "Expiring soon" within 7 days, then expiry. |

**Price list (per package, per city, per month, before 18% GST):**

| City Type | Retail & F\&B Package | Office Package |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Metro | ₹1,000 | ₹1,000 |
| Non-metro | ₹750 | ₹750 |
| Rest of India | ₹1,000 | ₹1,000 |
| Pan-India | ₹5,000 | ₹5,000 |

Managed Space is not sold by subscription. Keydemand lists it directly.

###### Module G — Projects (Developers and Managed Space Operators)

**Purpose:** Showcase developments and managed centres. Keydemand staff create them.

| Feature Name | Deduced Business Purpose | User Trigger / Input | Expected System Outcome |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Developer projects | Promote developments | Staff create through the Control Panel | Public by default. Appear in search and relevant-project rails. |
| Managed centres | Promote flexible-space centres | Staff create centres with desk and room types | Matched to managed-space demands only. |
| Brochures and plans | Marketing material | Upload PDFs and images | Large brochures are compressed automatically. |
| "List your project" | Lead capture for developers and operators | Short public form | A lead is filed and assigned to a Keydemand team member. |
| Project leads | Show interest and enquiries to the owner | Open leads | Interest and enquiry lists. |

###### Module H — Notifications

**Purpose:** Keep users informed through the channel they prefer, without spamming.

| Feature Name | Deduced Business Purpose | User Trigger / Input | Expected System Outcome |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Event catalogue | 31 defined events (enquiry received, contact approved, subscription changes, listing decisions and others) | System events | Message sent through the allowed channels. |
| Four channels | Reach users where they are | In-app, push, WhatsApp, email | Each event defines which channels apply. |
| Daily cap and digest | Avoid fatigue | Automatic | Self-initiated receipts don't count. Some events wait for the 18:00 digest. |
| Enterprise rule | Respect account-manager relationships | Automatic | Enterprise users get in-app and push only. |
| Preferences | User choice | Profile switches | Per-channel opt-in. |
| Delivery tracking | Know what was delivered | Provider callbacks | Bounced addresses are suppressed. |

###### 3\. End-to-End User Journeys

###### Journey 1 — Agent Joins and Posts a First Property

- **Actor:** A new broker.  
- **Prerequisites:** A mobile number that receives SMS. An email address is optional.  
1. The agent enters their phone number. The system checks whether the number is known.  
2. For a new number, the agent chooses **Agent** as their role.  
3. They enter the one-time code. A wrong or expired code shows an error, and repeated attempts are rate-limited.  
4. They complete their profile: photo, name, email, bio, states, cities and asset classes. They can save progress and finish later.  
5. They open **Post Property** and pick an asset class. The form shows the fields for that class.  
6. They save. Email is optional, so nothing blocks posting.  
7. **Production:** the listing is saved as pending and waits for Keydemand approval. **Test environments:** it goes live immediately.  
8. A Keydemand reviewer approves it, or rejects it with a written reason. The agent is notified either way.  
9. A second property attempt shows "Free limit reached" and explains how to subscribe (Journey 2).

###### Journey 2 — Agent Subscribes to Unlock More

- **Actor:** An agent who has used the free listing or free contact reveals.  
- **Prerequisites:** A signed-in agent account.  
1. The agent opens **Agent Subscription** or hits a paywall message.  
2. They select cities and a package: Retail & F\&B, Office, or both.  
3. The price quote shows the subtotal, 18% GST and the total.  
4. They pay through the Razorpay checkout.  
5. **Success:** Payment is confirmed in two ways, the browser return and a server confirmation. Coverage begins and lasts 30 days. A receipt and invoice are sent.  
6. **Failure:** The order stays unpaid. A background check every 30 minutes settles any payment that succeeded but wasn't recorded.  
7. The agent can now post in covered cities and reveal contacts without limit there.  
8. Seven days before expiry the plan shows "expiring soon". After expiry the free limits apply again.

###### Journey 3 — Brand Posts a Requirement and Gets Matched

- **Actor:** A retail or F\&B brand user.  
- **Prerequisites:** A registered brand account.  
1. The brand signs up with a phone number and chooses **Retail Brand** or **F\&B Brand**. A brand record is created.  
2. They open **Post Demand** and fill in city, preferred localities, area, ceiling height, floor, store type, possession date and other class-specific needs.  
3. The system checks free limits. A fourth demand shows an Enterprise pitch.  
4. The system checks the high-value rules. A large requirement in a major city is hidden from agents and assigned to Keydemand (Journey 5).  
5. The system matches the demand to live properties and projects that pass the hard filters, and scores each one.  
6. The brand sees matches of 50% or more, best first, and gets a daily digest.  
7. The brand opens a match and taps **View number**. Free reveals are used first.  
8. After 5 reveals the brand sees an Enterprise prompt and is routed to sales.

###### Journey 4 — Contact Reveal and Approval Between Two Parties

- **Actor:** A requester (agent or tenant) and the listing's owner.  
- **Prerequisites:** Both accounts are active. The listing is live and visible to the requester.  
1. The requester taps **View number** on a property or demand.  
2. If the number was already revealed, it shows again at no cost.  
3. The system checks that the listing is still live and that the requester is in its audience. Otherwise the requester sees "unavailable".  
4. The system applies the paywall: subscription coverage, or a free reveal, or an upgrade prompt.  
5. **Property or ordinary demand:** The number reveals at once. The owner is notified and sees an inbound lead.  
6. **Brand demand:** A contact request goes to the brand. The number is revealed only when the brand accepts. If nobody responds, the request expires after 72 hours.  
7. **Demand Keydemand holds for a brand:** The Keydemand member's phone is shown under the brand's name with no approval step. The brand's users are also notified.  
8. For hidden photos, the requester sends an image request. When the owner approves, they see all photos from then on.

###### Journey 5 — High-Value Lead Routed to Keydemand

- **Actor:** Keydemand operations and a relationship manager.  
- **Prerequisites:** A matching HVL rule exists for the city and asset class. The demand was not posted by an agent and is not managed space.  
1. A tenant or brand posts a large requirement in one of the eight major cities.  
2. The system matches it to a rule on city, asset class, transaction type and minimum size.  
3. The demand is hidden from agents. A lead is created with status **New** and appears in the Control Panel.  
4. Staff assign it to one or more team members (**Assigned**).  
5. The team contacts the customer directly.  
6. When ready, staff **unlock** the lead. Agents are added only if the poster allowed them, otherwise the unlock is refused with a clear message.  
7. A subscribed agent is notified only if they own a live property that matches and sits in their coverage.  
8. The lead moves to **Serviced**. If the demand ends or the rules change, the lead is **Withdrawn**.

###### 4\. Key Business Entities & Data Lifecycle

###### Entity Glossary

| Entity | Plain-English Definition |
| :---- | :---- |
| **User** | A person with one of seven roles. Holds profile, coverage areas, free-limit counters and notification choices. |
| **Company / Brand** | The organisation behind a brand or enterprise tenant. Free demand limits are counted per brand, not per person. |
| **Property** | A unit of supply with an asset class, city, location, area, pricing, photos, documents and an audience. |
| **Demand** | A requirement with an asset class, cities, area, possession date and class-specific needs. |
| **Project** | A developer project or managed-space centre, with units, brochures and floor plans. |
| **Enquiry** | A request between two parties. Types: property, demand match, image request, project enquiry, contact request, project interest, general and marketing lead. |
| **Contact Unlock** | A record that someone has seen someone else's number and why (free, subscription, owner, approved or Keydemand). |
| **Subscription** | An agent's paid cycle with coverage by city and package. |
| **Payment** | A Razorpay order and its outcome. |
| **High-Value Lead** | A large demand held by Keydemand, with assignees and status. |
| **HVL Rule** | A city, asset class and minimum size that makes a demand "high value". |
| **Lead** | A sales or onboarding contact: Enterprise enquiries, developer and operator sign-ups, marketing enquiries. |
| **Listing Draft** | Unfinished form data saved for later. |
| **Favourite / Saved item** | A user's shortlist. |
| **Notification** | A message in the notification centre, with a call-to-action. |
| **Bulk Import Job** | A spreadsheet upload with row-level review. |
| **Admin User, Role, Session** | Control Panel accounts, their permissions, and sign-in sessions. |
| **Audit and Activity Log** | A trail of staff and system actions. |
| **Reference data** | Cities, regions, amenities, formats and pricing by city. |

###### Lifecycle States

###### Property

| Stage | Meaning | What Moves It Forward |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Draft, pending review** | Saved and waiting for approval (production). | Staff approve or reject. |
| **Draft, rejected** | Sent back with a reason. | Staff approve after fixes. |
| **Active, approved** | Live in the marketplace. | Owner deactivates or completes the deal. |
| **Inactive** | Hidden by the owner or staff. Reversible. | Owner reactivates (no new review). |
| **Sold / Rented** | Deal complete. Leaves the marketplace. | Final. |
| **Deleted** | Hidden everywhere. | Owner or staff delete. |

A rejection of a live listing takes it down and closes its open enquiries. After the first enquiry response, four fields lock.

###### Demand

| Status | Meaning | What Moves It |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Draft** | Form in progress. | Owner submits. |
| **Active** | Live and being matched. Demands no longer expire. | Owner or team action. |
| **Inactive** | Paused. Also the result when the owner's account is paused. | Owner reactivates. |
| **Fulfilled** | Requirement met. | Owner marks it. |
| **Expired** | Past its end date. Rare under current rules. | Owner reactivates. |

Ending a demand in any way withdraws its high-value lead.

###### Enquiry

| Status | Meaning | What Moves It |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Open** | Waiting for the recipient. | Recipient responds, or 72 hours pass. |
| **Accepted** | Contact shared, or images granted. | Final. |
| **Rejected** | Declined. | Final. |
| **Expired** | No response in 72 hours. | Final. |
| **Closed** | The listing ended first. | Final. |

###### High-Value Lead

| Status | Meaning | What Moves It |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **New** | Created from a qualifying demand. | Staff assign. |
| **Assigned** | Owned by team members. | Staff unlock. |
| **Unlocked** | Released to eligible agents. | Servicing. |
| **Serviced** | Work complete. | Final. |
| **Expired / Withdrawn** | Demand ended or rules changed. | Final. |

###### Subscription and Payment

| Entity | States |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Subscription** | Active → Expiring soon (within 7 days) → Expired |
| **Payment** | Created → Captured → Paid, or Failed |

###### Sales Lead

| Status | Meaning |
| :---- | :---- |
| New → Contacted → Converted or Closed | Developer and operator leads are converted into accounts by staff. |

---

###### 5\. External Ecosystem & Integrations

| Service | Product Purpose | User Touchpoint |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Razorpay** | Subscription payments, payment confirmation and reconciliation | Checkout on the plan page, invoices |
| **MSG91** | SMS one-time codes in production | Sign-in code on the phone |
| **Interakt (WhatsApp Business)** | WhatsApp notifications and delivery status | Enquiry alerts, contact shared, reminders |
| **Amazon SES** | Email: notifications, Control Panel login codes, password reset, digests, newsletters and ops alerts | Inbox |
| **Firebase Cloud Messaging** | Mobile and browser push | Phone alerts |
| **Google Places and Static Maps** | Location picker and map images in PDFs | Post forms, location search, PDFs |
| **Amazon S3 and CloudFront** | Storage and fast delivery of photos, videos, documents and Keydemand's own media | Every image and download |
| **AWS Lambda (image, video, PDF processors)** | Automatic resizing, video previews and brochure compression | Faster-loading media |
| **Headless Chrome (PDF service)** | Builds PDFs | Download buttons |
| **MongoDB Atlas** | Primary database | None |
| **AWS hosting stack (ECS, load balancers, WAF, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, SSM)** | Hosting, scheduled jobs, rate limiting, alerting and secrets | None (operations only) |
| **Capacitor and app stores** | Packaging the web app as mobile apps | Apps on phones |
| **Legacy Keydemand v1** | Existing data and users, read-only through the bridge | Old listing links redirect to v2 |
| **GitHub Actions** | Build and deployment across four environments | None (engineering only) |

**Operational safeguards worth knowing:**

- **Messaging hold:** A switch that can block SMS, WhatsApp, email or push in a given environment. Production runs with it off.  
- **Test environments** send customer email only to an allow-list.  
- **Alarm emails:** Production alarms for errors, slowness, failed payments and failed jobs go to the DevOps group.

###### Source Notes

Derived from: persona and permission rules, free-limit and pricing settings, listing lifecycle and persona documents, the relevancy documentation, data models and statuses, both navigation definitions, the environment configuration guide, business rules documents and the notification event catalogue.&nbsp;

#### Business rules extracted
- **BR-PD-0001** — Keydemand is a two-sided marketplace for commercial real estate in India: agents list space, brands and tenants post what they need, and the platform matches the two. _(§ 0. Product Vision & Architecture Map › Vision)_
- **BR-PD-0002** — Asset classes are Retail, Food & Beverage (F&B), Office and Managed Space. _(§ 0 › Vision)_
- **BR-PD-0003** — Revenue comes from agent subscriptions by city, contact reveals beyond the free allowance, and an offline Enterprise sales motion for large brands and tenants. _(§ 0 › Vision)_
- **BR-PD-0004** — v2 is built beside the live v1 product; v1 data is read-only and v1 users sign in again on v2. _(§ 0 › Vision)_
- **BR-PD-0005** — Production has been live on keydemand.ai since 2026-10-21 (status date 2026-10-28). _(Header)_
- **BR-PD-0006** — The Admin API is a separate backend with its own login: email, password, plus an emailed code in production. _(§ 0 › Architecture-to-Product Map)_
- **BR-PD-0007** — The legacy bridge is the only allowed door to the old v1 platform. _(§ 0 › Architecture-to-Product Map)_
- **BR-PD-0008** — Media processors resize images, create video previews and compress large brochures after upload. _(§ 0 › Architecture-to-Product Map)_
- **BR-PD-0009** — Scheduled jobs cover payment reconciliation, subscription expiry, digests, newsletters and analytics snapshots. _(§ 0 › Architecture-to-Product Map)_
- **BR-PD-0010** — Matching today uses fixed, explainable rules; machine learning is a placeholder. _(§ 0 › Architecture-to-Product Map)_
- **BR-PD-0011** — Not built: real-time updates (notifications are fetched on a schedule), advanced search engines, ML ranking, and event messaging between services; six of the nine background "functions" are empty placeholders. _(§ 0 › Not built)_
- **BR-PD-0012** — Demands are private: only the poster and Keydemand staff browse them, and agents see only demands that match their own listings. _(§ 1. Product Overview & Target Personas › Who Can See What)_
- **BR-PD-0013** — Properties have audiences: a Keydemand-posted property can be limited to groups such as agents, office tenants, retail brands or F&B brands. _(§ 1 › Who Can See What)_
- **BR-PD-0014** — There are seven end-user roles and each user has exactly one; Control Panel operators are a separate account type. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0015** — Agent: posts properties and demands with 1 free listing in total shared between the two, then needs a subscription covering that city and asset class. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0016** — Agent reveals contacts: 5 free, then unlimited within paid coverage; an agent cannot post Managed Space. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0017** — Brand (Retail or F&B) posts demands in its own asset class (3 free, then pitched Enterprise). _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0018** — Brand explores retail, F&B and office properties and gets 5 free contact reveals. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0019** — Self-serve brands are "individual"; enterprise brands are set up by Keydemand. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0020** — Office Tenant posts 1 free demand (office or managed space), explores office and managed space, and gets 5 free contact reveals. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0021** — Enterprise tenants get unlimited demands and reveals, managed by Keydemand. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0022** — Managed Space Occupier posts 1 free demand, managed space only; otherwise same limits as the Office Tenant. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0023** — Developer is onboarded by Keydemand and cannot use the app beyond their profile and their Relationship Manager's details. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0024** — Managed Space Operator has the same restrictions as Developer and Keydemand creates their centres on the backend. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0025** — Keydemand Team posts on behalf of customers, approves listings, sees all enquiries and reveals contacts free. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0026** — Keydemand Team sub-roles in the code are Keydemand Agent and BRM (broker relationship manager, who also manages brokers). _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0027** — Each Keydemand Team toggle (for example "Explore Demand") can be switched per person. _(§ 1 › User Personas & Roles)_
- **BR-PD-0028** — Control Panel operator access is set by permissions grouped by area. _(§ 1 › Control Panel Operators)_
- **BR-PD-0029** — Super Admin has everything including system health settings and is fixed to two named people in every environment. _(§ 1 › Control Panel Operators)_
- **BR-PD-0030** — Admin has broad access to users, listings, subscriptions and enquiries. _(§ 1 › Control Panel Operators)_
- **BR-PD-0031** — Contributor has narrower access, mostly upload and review work. _(§ 1 › Control Panel Operators)_
- **BR-PD-0032** — Custom is a role built from individual permissions such as view users, edit listings, manage pricing, unlock high-value leads, bulk upload, or view insights. _(§ 1 › Control Panel Operators)_
- **BR-PD-0033** — Free allowance: Agent 1 listing in total (property or demand) and 5 contact reveals, prompted to subscribe at the limit. _(§ 1 › Free Allowances & Paywalls)_
- **BR-PD-0034** — Free allowance: Brand 3 demands and 5 contact reveals, pitched Enterprise at the limit. _(§ 1 › Free Allowances & Paywalls)_
- **BR-PD-0035** — Free allowance: Office Tenant 1 demand and 5 contact reveals; Managed Space Occupier 1 demand and 5 contact reveals; both pitched Enterprise at the limit. _(§ 1 › Free Allowances & Paywalls)_
- **BR-PD-0036** — Enterprise accounts have unlimited allowances and no paywall. _(§ 1 › Free Allowances & Paywalls)_
- **BR-PD-0037** — Sign-in is by phone number then a one-time code with no passwords for end users; new numbers continue to role selection. _(§ 2. Core Feature Catalog › Module A)_
- **BR-PD-0038** — Developers and operators are filed as leads instead of getting an account at role selection. _(§ 2 › Module A)_
- **BR-PD-0039** — Agent profile collects photo, name, email, bio, states, cities and asset classes; email is optional and there is no email-verification step. _(§ 2 › Module A)_
- **BR-PD-0040** — Brand profile (brand name, asset class, cities) creates a company and brand record behind the scenes. _(§ 2 › Module A)_
- **BR-PD-0041** — Self-service account controls are deactivate, reactivate and request deletion; listings hide or return, and enterprise accounts must go through Keydemand. _(§ 2 › Module A)_
- **BR-PD-0042** — Sessions are short-lived and refresh quietly. _(§ 2 › Module A)_
- **BR-PD-0043** — Post a property uses a shared form for all four asset classes; it goes live immediately or waits for approval depending on environment. _(§ 2 › Module B)_
- **BR-PD-0044** — Leaving the property form mid-way keeps a draft on the account. _(§ 2 › Module B)_
- **BR-PD-0045** — After the first enquiry, four identity fields lock on a property: asset class, transaction type, city, location. _(§ 2 › Module B; § 4 › Lifecycle States)_
- **BR-PD-0046** — "Who can see this" is ticked by group for Keydemand posts only and applies to browse, search, detail, documents and contact reveal. _(§ 2 › Module B)_
- **BR-PD-0047** — Hidden photos are seen only by the owner, Keydemand and approved requesters. _(§ 2 › Module B)_
- **BR-PD-0048** — Marking sold or rented, or deactivating, removes a property from the marketplace and closes open enquiries. _(§ 2 › Module B)_
- **BR-PD-0049** — Download PDF produces a branded PDF, cached for repeat use. _(§ 2 › Module B)_
- **BR-PD-0050** — The property "leads" view lists contact requests and image requests. _(§ 2 › Module B)_
- **BR-PD-0051** — Post a demand uses a shared form (asset class, city, localities, area, possession, class-specific needs); it is saved and matched to listings and free limits are enforced by persona. _(§ 2 › Module C)_
- **BR-PD-0052** — Fulfilled or inactive demands leave matching. _(§ 2 › Module C)_
- **BR-PD-0053** — High-value routing is automatic on posting: qualifying demands hide from agents and go to the Keydemand team. _(§ 2 › Module C)_

- **BR-PD-0055** — Demand PDF is generated from a download button. _(§ 2 › Module C)_
- **BR-PD-0056** — Home feed is chosen by city and shows featured, new and relevant listings. _(§ 2 › Module D)_

- **BR-PD-0058** — Explore returns paged results, newest or most-leads first, filtered by asset class, budget, area and city. _(§ 2 › Module D)_
- **BR-PD-0059** — % Match score is a percentage per pair, best first, and below 50% is hidden. _(§ 2 › Module D)_
- **BR-PD-0060** — Relevant demands for a property are listed on the owner's own property, and agents see only demands they are allowed to. _(§ 2 › Module D)_
- **BR-PD-0061** — Daily digest runs at 18:00 India time as a roll-up of new matches. _(§ 2 › Module D)_
- **BR-PD-0062** — Regions such as NCR, Mumbai region, Goa and Pune region widen the pool. _(§ 2 › Module D)_

- **BR-PD-0067** — Sending an enquiry notifies the recipient and it expires after 72 hours if unanswered. _(§ 2 › Module E)_
- **BR-PD-0068** — On accept of an enquiry both parties see each other's contact. _(§ 2 › Module E)_
- **BR-PD-0069** — "Request images": the owner approves and the requester sees all photos from then on. _(§ 2 › Module E)_
- **BR-PD-0070** — "View number" is instant for property and non-brand demands; brand demands need the brand's approval. _(§ 2 › Module E)_
- **BR-PD-0071** — Project "Show Interest" sends the lead to the project's Keydemand account manager. _(§ 2 › Module E)_
- **BR-PD-0072** — Received and sent tabs filter by phone requests, image requests and status. _(§ 2 › Module E)_

- **BR-PD-0090** — Delivery tracking uses provider callbacks and bounced addresses are suppressed. _(§ 2 › Module H)_

- **BR-PD-0093** — Control Panel areas: Dashboard, User Management, Listing Management, Bulk Upload, V1 Completion Queue, Subscription Management, High Value Leads (HVL), Enquiries, Control Panel Users, Email Domains, Account Deletions, Analytics and App Insights, Observability. _(§ 2 › Module J)_
- **BR-PD-0094** — Listing Management lets staff approve or reject new listings with a reason and post on behalf of a customer. _(§ 2 › Module J)_
- **BR-PD-0095** — Bulk Upload loads spreadsheets into a review queue, then rows are approved or rejected to go live. _(§ 2 › Module J)_
- **BR-PD-0096** — V1 Completion Queue finishes migrated v1 properties and agent profiles that came across incomplete. _(§ 2 › Module J)_

- **BR-PD-0102** — Journey 1: the agent enters a phone number and, for a new number, chooses Agent as role, then enters the one-time code; a wrong or expired code shows an error and repeated attempts are rate-limited. _(§ 3. End-to-End User Journeys › Journey 1 steps 1-3)_
- **BR-PD-0103** — Journey 1: the agent profile is photo, name, email, bio, states, cities and asset classes and progress can be saved to finish later. _(§ 3 › Journey 1 step 4)_

#### Open questions / ambiguities in this doc
- The Contents lists "6. Open Questions & Gaps to Confirm", but the document has no section 6; it ends with Source Notes (the open questions are missing or were dropped).
- Property lifecycle says "Active, approved" is reached from "Draft, pending review" only in production; the Property post says it "goes live immediately or waits for approval, depending on environment" without defining which environments (only "production" vs "test environments" is named in Journey 1).
- Demand "Expired" status exists ("Past its end date. Rare under current rules") while the document also says demands no longer expire.
- Price list shows Rest of India priced the same as Metro (₹1,000) and higher than Non-metro (₹750), which is unusual and not explained.
- "Reveal contacts (5 free, then unlimited within paid coverage)" for Agent vs Brand "5 free contact reveals" then pitched Enterprise: behaviour after 5 for brands/tenants is a pitch, not a stated block.
- Journey 4 prerequisite says the listing is "visible to the requester", while Module B says Keydemand-only audience controls; how agent-posted listings (open to everyone per the agent doc) interact is not stated here.
- Journey 5 says "one of the eight major cities" but the eight cities are not named in this document.
- Journey 3 says Brand "fourth demand shows an Enterprise pitch" and the persona table says "3 free, then pitched Enterprise" (consistent), but the Office Tenant and Managed Space Occupier pitch is said to be "Enterprise" without an in-app flow described.
- Daily digest: "18:00 India time" here, whereas the Agent doc states there is no daily digest for agents (matches are sent as they happen).
- Notifications: Module H says "Daily cap" exists but gives no number for the cap.
- Subscription renewal: Journey 2 describes coverage lasting 30 days and expiry, with no mention of auto-renew, while the Agent doc describes auto-renewal.
- Status-date header says "2026-10-28" while the DB schema count ("129 schema changes to date") has no date reference.
- Mobile app description says only "the web app packaged for iOS and Android stores" and does not mention the iOS purchase restrictions documented in the persona docs.

###### 1. Persona snapshot

| Aspect | Detail |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Who** | Anyone on the website or app who has not signed in. This includes a returning user who has not logged in yet, and a first-time visitor from search or a shared link. |
| **Goals** | Look at what is on the marketplace, judge whether it is worth joining, get a callback, or start sign-up. |
| **How they become a user** | Phone number and one-time code, then choose a role. The visitor flow ends where [sign-up](#flow-5--sign-up-and-first-login) begins. |
| **Asset-class scope** | Retail, F&B, Office and Managed Space are all browsable. Some listings are hidden from visitors by their "Who can see this" setting. |

###### What a visitor can do

- **Browse** properties and projects, with the city picker and filters.
- **Search** across properties and projects, by text, filters, a Keydemand listing ID or an old v1 listing number.
- **Read** the home feed, listing detail pages, similar properties and the public marketing pages.
- **Check prices** for an agent subscription (the quote needs no account).
- **Ask for a callback** or submit an enterprise or project enquiry, without signing up.
- **Download** a property or project PDF from a detail page only after signing up

###### What a visitor cannot do

| Blocked action | What happens instead |
| :---- | :---- |
| **See any demand** | Demands are private. They never appear in a visitor's search, and no page shows them. |
| **Reveal a phone number** | The "View number" action asks the visitor to register first. |
| **Send an enquiry or image request** | Needs a signed-in account. |
| **Save a favourite** | The heart icon sends the visitor to sign-in. |
| **Post a property or demand** | Sends the visitor to sign-in, then back to the form. |
| **See notifications, dashboard, profile, saved items** | Each sends the visitor to sign-in and returns them afterwards. |
| **Buy a subscription** | Checkout needs a signed-in agent account. |

Limits and paywalls

Visitors have no free allowances of their own. Allowances begin at registration (see the [Agent](./02-agent.md) file for the agent numbers).

---

###### 2. Screen and navigation map

###### Menus a visitor sees

The same navigation list drives four places: the top pill bar on desktop, the profile dropdown, the phone drawer and the phone bottom bar. A visitor sees each destination, but items that need an account send them to sign-in when tapped.

| Menu item | Visitor behaviour | Shown on |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Home** | Opens the landing page. | All four |
| **Explore Properties** ("Explore" on the bottom bar, "Properties" on the Menu tab) | Opens search, filtered to properties in the chosen city. | All four |
| **Projects** | Opens search, switched to projects. | Drawer and pill |
| **Post Property** | Sends to sign-in, with a return to the post form. | Drawer and pill |
| **Post Demand** | Sends to sign-in, with a return to the demand form. | Drawer and pill |
| **Profile** | Sends to sign-in. | Bottom bar, drawer |
| **Saved** | Sends to sign-in. | Drawer |
| **Notifications** | Not usable until signed in. | Drawer, bottom bar |
| **Agent Subscription** | Opens the plan builder and price quote (hidden on iOS, see below). | Drawer |
| **Enterprise Solution** | Opens the enterprise enquiry page (hidden on iOS). | Drawer |
| **About, Our Clients, Investor Relations, Contact, FAQs, Privacy, Terms, Cookie settings** | Public pages. | Menu pane / footer |

**Hidden from visitors:** Dashboard, Leads, Explore Demands and Relationship Manager appear only after sign-in, and only for the roles that have them.

###### The city selector

- The header shows a city control only on pages where the city changes the results: the home page, search and Explore Properties.
- On other pages the header shows the brand mark.

###### Mobile versus desktop

| Surface | Visitor experience |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Desktop** | Pill bar with Home, Explore, Projects, and so on. Profile dropdown holds sign-in and the same extras. |
| **Phone** | Bottom bar with Home, Explore, Menu and Profile. The Menu tab and drawer carry everything else. |
| **iOS app** | Anything that sells or advertises a subscription is hidden, including the plan builder, rate cards and Enterprise Solution. The app is positioned as a free companion to the paid web tool. Android and web keep the full experience. |

###### Public pages and what each does

| Page | Purpose | Visitor action |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Home** | Landing: hero search, city chips, "how it works", featured and new properties, projects, clients, testimonials, recent searches. | Search, pick a city, open a card. |
| **Search / Explore Properties** | Filterable results for properties and projects. | Filter, sort, page, open a card. |
| **Listing detail** | Full property or project detail. | Read, share, see similar. Contact actions ask for sign-in. |
| **View all properties** | A longer, unfiltered list. | Browse. |
| **Agent Subscription** | Plan builder with price quote. | Pick cities and packages, see total with GST. |
| **Enterprise Solution** | Product pitch for large accounts, with an enquiry form. | Submit the form. |
| **List your project** | Intake for developers and managed-space operators. | Submit the form (needs a verified phone). |
| **About, Our Clients, Investor Relations** | Corporate content. | Read. |
| **Contact** | Contact details. | Read. |
| **FAQs** | Help content. | Read. |
| **Privacy policy, Terms and conditions, Cookie settings** | Legal and consent. | Read, set cookie choices. |
| **Delete account** | Public information on how deletion works. | Read, or email the grievance officer if signed out. |
| **Old v1 links** | Old v1 listing, project and demand links. | Redirect to the matching v2 page. |
| **Sitemap and robots** | Search-engine files. | n/a |

---

###### 3. End-to-end flows

###### Flow 1 — Browse the home page and pick a city

- **Actor:** Visitor.
- **Prerequisites:** None.

1. The visitor lands on the home page. It loads a curated feed for a default city, with images stripped.
2. They pick a city from the header chips or the "Explore cities" and "Popular cities" blocks.
3. The page updates to that city's featured, new and project cards. The chosen city is remembered for later searches.
4. A "Recent searches" bar offers one-tap repeats of earlier searches on the same device.
5. Cards show asset class, price, area and location. They do not show photos.
6. Tapping a card opens its detail page ([Flow 3](#flow-3--open-a-listing-and-hit-a-sign-in-wall)).

**System side-effects:** none stored on the server. City choice and recent searches live in the visitor's own browser.

**Edge cases**

- If a city has no listings, the page shows an empty state rather than an error.
- Regions group neighbouring cities, so a search for one city can include the others in its region (for example NCR, the Mumbai region, Goa and the Pune region).
- A listing whose "Who can see this" setting excludes visitors never appears, even though a direct link may be known.

###### Flow 2 — Search and filter

- **Actor:** Visitor.
- **Prerequisites:** None.

1. The visitor opens Explore Properties or types in the home search bar.
2. They set filters: city, asset class, lease or buy, locality, and class-specific ranges such as area, rent, seats and ceiling height.
3. Results show properties and projects together, with a toggle to narrow to one. There is no demands option.
4. They can sort and page through results. The count updates as filters change.
5. They can search by a Keydemand listing ID or by an old v1 listing number. A v1 number opens the v2 equivalent.
6. A card opens the detail page.

**Validation and errors**

- A search with no match shows "No results". Clear filters is offered.
- An unknown or retired listing ID shows a "not found" state.

**System side-effects:** none stored, apart from analytics events.

**Edge cases**

- Visitors never see demands, even if they search for a requirement ID.
- A property hidden from visitors does not appear in search, ID lookup or v1-number lookup.
- Projects show to visitors unless their "Who can see this" setting restricts them.

###### Flow 3 — Open a listing and hit a sign-in wall

- **Actor:** Visitor.
- **Prerequisites:** The listing is visible to visitors.

1. The visitor opens a property or project page.
2. They see the heading, key facts, specifications, location and commercial terms. A "similar properties" rail follows.
3. Photos show. For a property whose owner hid images, the page also says buyers must request access.
4. They tap **View number**, **Enquire**, **Request images** or the **heart**.
5. A prompt explains the benefits of registering: free account, one free listing, five free contact views, matching and saved favourites. A "Sign in / Register" button follows.
6. They sign in or register. After success they return to this same listing, ready to retry.

**System side-effects:** none until sign-in. After sign-in, the action itself is not auto-completed **(inferred)**, so the user taps it again.

**Edge cases**

- A listing deactivated while the visitor is reading it shows "unavailable" on the next load.
- A project page lets a visitor use **Show Interest**, but the interest needs a registered number (see [Flow 6](#flow-6--project-show-interest)).

###### Flow 4 — Get a quote for an agent subscription

- **Actor:** Visitor, usually a broker.
- **Prerequisites:** Android or web (not the iOS app).

1. The visitor opens **Agent Subscription**.
2. The plan builder groups cities into Metro, Non-Metro and Rest of India, with a Nationwide (Pan-India) option.
3. They choose cities and a package: Retail & F&B, Office, or both. Managed Space is not on offer.
4. A summary shows the plan subtotal, 18% GST and the monthly total. It reads "Billed every month until cancelled" (the product itself requires a manual renewal each cycle, see [Section 7](#7-open-questions--gaps--not-built)).
5. Choosing **Subscribe** while signed out sends the visitor to sign-in. The role screen offers only "Property Agent" in this flow, because the subscription is for agents.
6. After the account is created, they return to the plan builder to pay (see the [Agent file](./02-agent.md), Flow 21).

**Price list (before GST, per package, per city, per month):**

| City type | Retail & F&B | Office |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Metro | ₹1,000 | ₹1,000 |
| Non-metro | ₹750 | ₹750 |
| Rest of India | ₹1,000 | ₹1,000 |
| Pan-India | ₹5,000 | ₹5,000 |

**Edge cases**

- On the iOS app the plan builder, prices and Subscribe buttons are hidden. A visitor there sees the free experience only.
- A visitor who is already a non-agent role (after sign-in) is sent to their dashboard with a note that the subscription is for agents.

###### Flow 5 — Sign-up and first login

- **Actor:** Visitor becoming a user.
- **Prerequisites:** A mobile phone that can receive an SMS.

1. **Enter the number.** The visitor types a 10-digit mobile number. An empty or short entry shows "Enter your mobile number" or "Enter a valid 10-digit number".
2. **Accept consent.** A tick box confirms they are over 18 and agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Without it the form says "Please accept the Terms of Use & Privacy Policy to continue". Both documents open in a side sheet.
3. **Continue.** The system checks whether the number is known.
   - **Known number:** a one-time code is sent, and the visitor goes to the verify screen.
   - **Unknown number:** the visitor goes to role selection.
4. **Choose a role.** The cards are Property Agent ("Sell or lease commercial spaces"), Retail Brand ("Find retail space for your brand"), F&B Brand ("Find restaurant or café space"), Tenant ("Are you looking for office or managed spaces?", then Office Tenant or Managed Space Tenant), Developer ("Enquire to list projects") and Managed Space Operator ("Enquire to list spaces"). A visitor who abandoned a previous sign-up is offered a one-tap resume of the role they picked.
5. **Receive the code.** A 6-digit code is sent by SMS. Resend is blocked for 30 seconds, and the screen shows a countdown. More than three requests in five minutes shows "Too many OTP requests. Try again in N seconds."
6. **Verify.** A wrong code shows "Invalid code". An expired code shows "Your code expired. Tap Resend for a new one." Too many wrong attempts shows "Too many attempts. Request a new code."
7. **Register.** The next screen depends on the role. See the persona files for the exact forms.
8. **Land.** The user returns to the page they came from, or to the home page. A Keydemand team member lands on the dashboard.

**Who ends up where**

| Role chosen | Result |
| :---- | :---- |
| Agent | Profile form, then signed in immediately. |
| Brand, Office Tenant, Managed Space Tenant | Profile form plus a first requirement, then signed in. |
| Developer, Managed Space Operator | A lead is filed for the Keydemand team. No login is created. The visitor sees a "Got it" screen. |

**System side-effects**

- A pending-sign-up marker is saved as soon as a role is picked, so abandoned sign-ups can be followed up and resumed.
- A welcome notification (event 1) goes to every new account. A "profile incomplete" nudge on WhatsApp follows after 24 hours if the profile stays incomplete.
- Consent (terms and over-18) is stamped with a time on the account.

**Edge cases**

- If another person registers the same number between the two steps, the visitor sees "User already exists for this phone".
- A deactivated, removed or unapproved account cannot sign in. The reasons are shown in plain words ("account removed", "contact support", "pending Keydemand review").
- A visitor who started from a listing, a form or the plan builder is returned there after success.
- A short link may carry a requirement to post right after sign-up. If posting then fails, the success screen says so.

###### Flow 6 — Project "Show Interest"

- **Actor:** Visitor.
- **Prerequisites:** A project is visible to visitors.

1. The visitor opens a project page and taps **Show Interest**.
2. A visitor is asked to register first. A signed-in user's interest is sent with their profile details.
3. The interest is routed to the project's Keydemand relationship manager and the super admins.

**System side-effects:** a project-interest lead is created. Developers and the Keydemand team are notified (see [Section 4](#4-notifications)).

**Edge cases:** the Control Panel also lists a "Managed office interest" source for visitors who ask about managed office from a demand context. How a visitor reaches that source is **(inferred)**.

###### Flow 7 — Request a callback

- **Actor:** Visitor.
- **Prerequisites:** None.

1. On the home page, the visitor taps **Request a callback**.
2. They fill in Full name, a 10-digit phone number, Email (optional) and Message (optional, for example city, asset class and size).
3. They submit. A thank-you confirmation appears.
4. The enquiry is filed as a "landing callback" lead for the Keydemand team.

**Validation:** name and phone are required. An invalid phone shows an inline error.

**System side-effects:** a lead with status New is created and appears in the Control Panel and in the Keydemand team's Leads view.

###### Flow 8 — Enterprise Solution enquiry

- **Actor:** Visitor from a large brand or tenant.
- **Prerequisites:** Not on the iOS app.

1. The visitor opens **Enterprise Solution** and reads the pitch: unlimited listings, dashboard and multi-user access, transaction assistance, locality insights, AI recommendations, and coverage for retail, corporate HQ, managed portfolios, logistics parks and regional hubs.
2. They fill in Full name, Company, Email, WhatsApp number and Primary city focus.
3. Errors shown inline: "Please enter your full name", "Please enter your company", "Enter a valid email", "Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number".
4. On submit they see "Thank you for your enquiry. We have received your details. Our team will be in touch."

**System side-effects:** a lead is filed with the Enterprise source. If the visitor is signed in, the lead is linked to their account.

**Edge cases:** the older "Enterprise" address redirects permanently to this page. An enterprise brand cannot be created through normal sign-up. Choosing enterprise at registration shows a message that enterprise accounts are set up by Keydemand.

###### Flow 9 — List your project (developers and operators)

- **Actor:** A developer or managed-space operator.
- **Prerequisites:** A phone number that can be verified.

1. The visitor opens **List your project**, or a modal with the same form on another page.
2. They prove their phone number with a one-time code.
3. They submit their details, including company, designation, city, official email and GST or CIN.
4. The Keydemand team receives the lead and an operations email. No account is created.
5. A repeat submission from the same phone and role updates the open lead.

**Validation messages:** "Name is required", "Company name is required", "Designation is required", "City is required", "Official email is required".

**System side-effects:** lead created (status New), operations email sent, no login. Keydemand later assigns, contacts and converts the lead.

###### Flow 10 — Cookie choices, legal pages and help

- **Actor:** Visitor.

1. **Cookie settings:** the visitor can save their cookie choices, and gets a "Cookie settings saved" message.
2. **Terms, Privacy:** the pages open in full or in a side sheet during sign-up.
3. **FAQs and Contact:** read-only help content.
4. **Delete account:** a signed-out visitor can read what deletion removes and what is retained where required. They are offered an email to the grievance officer, because the in-app delete request needs sign-in.

###### Flow 11 — Old v1 links

- **Actor:** Anyone following an old Keydemand v1 link.

1. They open an old property, project or demand link.
2. The system looks up the v1 reference and sends them to the matching v2 page.
3. If the listing is hidden from visitors, or no longer exists, they see a "not found" state.

---

###### 4. Notifications

Visitors receive no notifications. They have no account, no preferences and no in-app inbox.

| Event | When | Channel | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Welcome** | First sign-up completes | In-app, WhatsApp, email | Starts after the visitor becomes a user. |
| **Profile incomplete** | 24 hours after sign-up with an incomplete profile | WhatsApp | Starts after the visitor becomes a user. |
| **Lead acknowledgement** | A callback, enterprise or project lead is filed | Staff are alerted through the Control Panel and operations email | The submitter is not sent a message **(inferred)**. They see only the on-screen thank-you. |

---

###### 5. Limits and rules

| Rule | Value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Photos visible | Yes |
| Demands visible | None |
| Free actions | Browse, search, quote, callback and enterprise and project enquiries |
| Registration age | 18 and over, confirmed by tick box |
| One-time code | 6 digits. Resend after 30 seconds. At most 3 sends in 5 minutes. |
| Phone format | 10-digit Indian mobile number on the form |
| Role choices at sign-up | Agent, Retail Brand, F&B Brand, Office Tenant, Managed Space Tenant, Developer, Managed Space Operator |
| Listing audience | A property may be limited to certain groups. A visitor sees only the open ones. |
| Subscription | Agents only. Retail & F&B and Office packages. 30-day cycle. 18% GST. |
| iOS app | No purchase screens, prices or "Enterprise Solution" |

---

###### 6. Coverage checklist

**Web app routes covered:** Home, Search, Explore Properties, View all properties, Property detail, Project detail, Agent Subscription, My Plan (redirect only), Enterprise Solution, Enterprise (redirect), List your project, About, About us, Our Clients, Investor Relations, Contact, FAQs, Privacy, Privacy policy, Terms, Terms and conditions, Cookie settings, Delete account, Sign-in entry, Phone, Verify, Role, Tenant type, Register, Success, Menu, old v1 redirects, Properties, Projects, Demands, Favorites and Agents (all redirects), Sitemap, Robots.

**Core API areas covered:** sign-in and registration, cities and listing counts, configuration, search and search locations, home feed and lead intake, property and project reads, subscription price quote.

**Routes not applicable to visitors:** Dashboard, Profile, Profile edit, Account, Saved, Notifications, Leads, My Plan (agent only), Post Property, Post Demand, Edit property, Edit demand, Demand detail.

- **BR-PD-0262** — Lead acknowledgement: when a callback, enterprise or project lead is filed, staff are alerted through the Control Panel and operations email; the submitter is sent no message and sees only the on-screen thank-you (inferred). _(§ 4. Notifications)_
- **BR-PD-0263** — Visitors can see no demands. _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_
- **BR-PD-0264** — Free actions for a visitor are browse, search, quote, callback and enterprise and project enquiries. _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_
- **BR-PD-0265** — Registration age is 18 and over, confirmed by tick box. _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_
- **BR-PD-0266** — The one-time code is 6 digits with resend after 30 seconds and at most 3 sends in 5 minutes. _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_
- **BR-PD-0267** — The phone format on the form is a 10-digit Indian mobile number. _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_
- **BR-PD-0268** — Role choices at sign-up are Agent, Retail Brand, F&B Brand, Office Tenant, Managed Space Tenant, Developer, Managed Space Operator. _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_
- **BR-PD-0269** — A property may be limited to certain groups and a visitor sees only the open ones. _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_
- **BR-PD-0270** — Subscription is for agents only: Retail & F&B and Office packages, 30-day cycle, 18% GST. _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_
- **BR-PD-0271** — The iOS app has no purchase screens, prices or "Enterprise Solution". _(§ 5. Limits and rules)_

#### Open questions / ambiguities in this doc
- The Contents lists "7. Open questions / gaps / not built" and "8. Source appendix", but the file has no open-questions section; section 7 is the Source appendix. Flow 4 and Flow 6 point to a "Section 7" that does not hold the referenced content.
- Flow 4 says the summary reads "Billed every month until cancelled" while noting the product itself requires a manual renewal each cycle (the Agent doc describes auto-renewal), so renewal behaviour is inconsistent.
- Section 5 says "Photos visible: Yes" for visitors, but Flow 1 says home cards show no photos, the product documentation says signed-out visitors see no photos, and the Brand doc says photos are hidden when signed out (contradiction).
- Section 1 says visitors may download a property or project PDF "only after signing up", but listing it under what a visitor "can do" is ambiguous.
- After sign-in the original action (View number, Enquire, Request images, heart) is not auto-completed, so the user taps it again (inferred, not confirmed).
- How a visitor reaches the "Managed office interest" lead source is inferred, not confirmed.
- Lead acknowledgement: that the submitter gets no message (only the on-screen thank-you) is inferred.
- Flow 6 says a visitor may tap Show Interest but must register first; the Brand doc says a signed-out visitor sees a short enquiry form instead (inconsistent).
- Flow 5 lists a "Tenant" role card that splits into Office Tenant or Managed Space Tenant, whereas the Brand doc lists four cards on the role screen (Property Agent, Retail Brand, F&B Brand, Office / Managed Space Tenant) and omits Developer and Managed Space Operator.
- The "Got it" screen for Developer and Managed Space Operator is stated but its exact text and the "pending Keydemand review" case for unapproved accounts are not defined.
- The Agent doc is linked as "./02-agent.md" for allowances; the actual agent numbers (1 free listing, 5 reveals) are not stated in this doc beyond the sign-in prompt text.

###### 1. Persona snapshot

| Aspect | Detail |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Who** | An independent or firm-based commercial real estate broker. They hold space to lease or sell on behalf of landlords. |
| **Goals** | List space, find brands and tenants who want it, and get contact details quickly. |
| **How onboarded** | Self-serve. Phone number and one-time code, choose "Property Agent", complete a short profile. Signed in straight away. |
| **Subscription** | Agents are the **only** persona that can buy a subscription. |
| **Asset-class scope** | The agent chooses asset classes at sign-up (Retail, F&B, Office, Managed Space). Properties are limited to those classes. Demands are not class-limited. |
| **Account states** | Registered (free), Subscribed, Expiring soon (within 7 days of renewal) and Expired. |

###### What an agent can do

- **Post properties** (1 free, then needs paid coverage for that city and asset class).
- **Post demands** (a requirement for a client). The first free listing is shared with properties, see [Section 5](#5-limits-and-rules).
- **See matches:** relevant demands for each property, and relevant properties and projects for any demand they own.
- **Reveal contact numbers** (5 free, then unlimited inside paid coverage).
- **Send and answer enquiries** and image requests.
- **Buy, extend, cancel and renew** a subscription, and download invoices.
- **Manage their own account:** profile, notification choices, deactivate, delete request.

###### What an agent cannot do

| Blocked action | Why |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Browse the demand marketplace** | Demands are private. Agents reach a demand only through a match with one of their own live properties. |
| **See who posted a demand** | The poster's name, brand and company are always hidden. Contact comes only through an accepted request. |
| **Post in a city not covered** | When subscribed, posting is limited to covered city and package pairs. |
| **Buy Managed Space coverage** | Managed Space is not sold by subscription. |
| **Use developer, brand or tenant features** | Different roles. |
| **Subscribe on the iOS app** | Purchase screens are hidden there (see [Flow 21](#flow-21--subscribe-pay-and-activate)). |

###### Paywalls at a glance

| Moment | Free agent | Subscribed agent (covered) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Post a property or demand | 1 in total | Unlimited in covered city and package pairs |
| Reveal a phone number | 5 in total | Unlimited in covered pairs |
| Request hidden photos | Allowed | Allowed |

###### 2. Screen and navigation map

###### Menu items an agent sees

| Menu item | Where it goes | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Home** | Landing page and city feed | |
| **Explore Properties** ("Explore" on the bottom bar) | Search, filtered to the chosen city | Agents explore properties, not demands. |
| **Projects** | Search, projects view | |
| **Post Property** | Property form | |
| **Post Demand** | Demand form | |
| **Dashboard** | Own listings, leads, matches | |
| **Profile** | Profile, preferences, plan summary | |
| **Saved** | Favourites | |
| **Notifications** | Notification centre, with unread badge | |
| **Subscription** ("My Plan" on iOS) | Plan builder, or the current plan | Hidden for other roles. |
| **Agent Subscription** (drawer banner) | Plan builder | Disappears once the agent has paid. |
| **Enterprise Solution** (drawer) | Enterprise enquiry page | Hidden on iOS. |

**Not shown to agents:** Leads (Keydemand team only), Explore Demands (Keydemand team only), Relationship Manager (enterprise accounts only), Add Centre (retired).

###### Dashboard areas

The dashboard shows tabs. The exact set was read from the page definition, and the order should be confirmed in the running app **(inferred)**.

| Tab | What it shows |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Overview** | Counts for listings, leads, favourites, matches and the plan, plus an "Unfinished listings, pick up where you left off" banner for drafts. |
| **Properties** | The agent's listings. Each has Edit, Activate or Deactivate, and Delete. A filter by asset class and status. |
| **Demands** | The agent's own demands. |
| **Leads (received)** | Contact requests, image requests and "phone numbers viewed" on the agent's listings. |
| **Enquiries (sent)** | Projects enquired, numbers the agent has viewed, contacts requested, images requested. |
| **Relevancy panel and updates** | Counts of relevant demands, properties and projects, with the scorer version. |

###### Mobile versus desktop

| Surface | Experience |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Desktop** | Pill bar, profile dropdown, full dashboard. |
| **Phone** | Bottom bar (Home, Explore, Menu, Profile), drawer with the rest. |
| **iOS app** | Plan builder, prices and Subscribe buttons are removed. "My Plan" shows the plan the agent already holds, renewal date and past invoices. The free tier stays fully usable. |
